title: Quality Assurance Engineer
teaser: Quality Assurance Engineer defining and governing product quality standards across the product lifecycle.
bullet_points: Five-day work week; 18 days AL + 1 day BL; work-life balance
Flexible and friendly working environment with vibrant employee engagement
Quarterly bonus; Profit Share; life, medical & dental insurance
jd:
Main Purpose of the Team
>
>The Global Product Quality Team serves as the centre of excellence and governance authority for product quality, safety, and regulatory compliance across a growing, multi‑category portfolio. Operating from Asia as the global quality hub, the team defines and enforces global quality frameworks across four pillars: Regulatory & Compliance, Quality Assurance (QA), Quality Control (QC), and Quality Analytics.
>
>The Quality Assurance team defines product standards, safety and testing requirements, and preventive frameworks that guide product design and supplier validation.
>Main Purpose of the Role
>
>The Quality Assurance Engineer is responsible for defining, governing, and assuring product quality standards throughout the product lifecycle, from design and development through to production readiness.
The role acts as the quality framework owner, ensuring that products, suppliers, and processes are capable of consistently meeting regulatory, safety, and internal quality requirements before mass production and market release.
>
Key Responsibilities
Product & Process Quality Definition
· Develop and maintain product quality standards, specifications, acceptance criteria, validation plans, and quality deliverables in line with global product quality and regulatory requirements.
· Responsible for design and pre-production risk assessments covering drawings, specifications, tooling, materials, where applicable, to identify quality, safety, performance, reliability, and durability risks early.
· Define testing reliability and compliance requirements, and ensure they are embedded into product development, design-change, and production-readiness processes.
>
>
Supplier & Capability Assurance
· Evaluate and approve supplier quality capability, production readiness, and control plans prior to mass production.
· Review and approve tooling samples, sealed samples, and testing reports as official quality references.
· Responsible for quality activities includes supplier onboarding, resourcing, and transition activities from a quality assurance perspective.
>
>
Regulatory & Compliance Alignment
· Ensure products meet applicable regulatory, medical device, and market‑specific requirements in partnership with the Quality Regulatory & Compliance team.
· Review and approve third‑party lab testing strategies and results before production and shipment.
· Maintain accurate documentation and traceability to support regulatory compliance and audit readiness.
>
Quality System & Continuous Improvement
· Own and execute defined Quality Assurance processes, risk registers, quality deliverables, tools, and governance frameworks across assigned product categories and suppliers.
· Facilitate structured root cause analysis and CAPA activities by contributing upstream risk analysis and preventive actions.
· Analyse recurring or systemic quality risks and product-performance data, and develop practical improvements to standards, specifications, supplier controls, or validation approaches.
· Drive lessons learned and risk prevention through collaboration with Quality Analytics and global stakeholders.
>
Cross‑Functional Collaboration
· Act as the quality partner to Category Operations, Category Development and Buying Teams.
· Provide clear technical guidance on quality requirements, risk trade‑offs, and readiness status to support informed business decisions.
· Escalate quality‑related risks, deviations, or decision blockers to the Quality Assurance Manager in a timely and structured manner.
· Support alignment with Quality Control teams by ensuring inspection standards, defect definitions, and acceptance criteria are clearly understood and applied.
Skills, Ability or Experience
· Tertiary education in engineering-related disciplines
· Experience in eyewear related purchasing / manufacturing environment, preferably within quality assurance / product engineering function
· 3 years or more of relevant quality assurance/product engineering, or product development experience, including independent management of multiple suppliers, technical workstreams, and product launches
· Preferred: hands-on experience with smart glasses, connected eyewear, wearable electronics, or consumer electronic products, including product validation, supplier quality, reliability testing, and production launch.
· Working knowledge of product risk assessment, reliability planning, root cause analysis; familiarity with hardware-software interface validation is an advantage.
· Good written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, analytical problem-solving, and technical decision-making skills, with the ability to influence suppliers and collaborate effectively across local and global teams

title: Quality & Compliance Manager
teaser: Join a growing global athletic brand that is expanding its reach from the US to Europe, Asia, and Beyond.
jd:
Quality & Compliance Manager
Location: Hong Kong
>
About the Role
HydraPak is looking for an experienced Quality & Compliance Manager to lead product quality, regulatory compliance, and laboratory testing across our operations in Hong Kong, China, and our supplier base in the Asia region.
Based in Hong Kong, this role will work closely with our global Engineering team, HK Merchandising teams, US Operations, contract manufacturers, suppliers, third-party inspection agencies, and testing laboratories.
A major focus of the position is ensuring that HydraPak products and materials intended for food and drinking-water contact meet applicable global regulatory and safety requirements. The Manager will own our compliance testing program, work directly with laboratories such as SGS and Intertek, evaluate test results, maintain compliance documentation, and stay current on changing regulations.
This is a hands-on position for someone who can combine manufacturing quality expertise with strong technical and regulatory knowledge.
>
Key Responsibilities
· Own HydraPak’s global product compliance program for food- and drinking-water-contact products and materials.
· Develop and manage annual and product-specific laboratory testing programs, including determining appropriate tests, frequency, and applicable standards.
· Coordinate testing with SGS, Intertek, and other qualified laboratories and review test reports for compliance.
· Investigate failed or unexpected laboratory results and coordinate root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and retesting.
· Coordinate operations of 3rd Party Inspection teams that handle weekly OQC of finished goods across multiple factories
· Manage and train remote QC Inspection contractors that work in multiple regions in Asia
· Maintain current knowledge of applicable global food-contact regulations, including EU EC Regulations, US FDA, REACH, LFGB, JFRL, and China GB standards.
· Maintain compliance records for materials, components, products, test reports, certifications, and declarations of compliance.
· Review current and new materials including: TPU, plastics molded components, inks, packaging, and other materials for quality and regulatory risks.
· Establish and enforce HydraPak quality standards across all contract manufacturers and subcontractors
· Oversee third-party inspection activities and coordinate weekly outgoing quality inspections with factories and the Merchandising team.
· Regularly visit suppliers to evaluate manufacturing processes, quality systems, and compliance with HydraPak requirements.
· Work with Engineering on new product development, quality specifications, testing methods, and product revisions.
· Review factory quality records and implement corrective and preventive actions when necessary.
· Support supplier qualification, quality improvement, and resolution of significant manufacturing issues.
· Maintain and improve HydraPak’s quality and compliance SOPs, testing protocols, and documentation systems.
· Travel regularly to primary factory base in China and suppliers and Asia region, including occasional emergency travel when significant quality issues require immediate attention.
>
Qualifications
· Bachelor’s degree in Quality Management, Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, Food Science, Regulatory Affairs, or a related field.
· 5+ years of experience in product quality, regulatory compliance, laboratory testing, supplier quality, or manufacturing quality.
· Strong understanding of food-contact materials and product safety requirements.
· Experience managing laboratory testing programs and interpreting technical laboratory reports.
· Working knowledge of U.S. FDA food-contact requirements, EU food-contact regulations, REACH, LFGB, and/or China GB standards.
· Experience working with laboratories such as SGS, Intertek, TÜV, Bureau Veritas, or similar organizations.
· Strong understanding of plastics manufacturing and injection molding; experience with TPU, polymers, inks, adhesives, or coatings is highly desirable.
· Experience with supplier quality management, third-party inspections, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
· Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
· Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively with Engineering, Merchandising, Operations, suppliers, and laboratories.
· Strong ability to communicate and enforce quality and compliance requirements with manufacturing partners.
· Excellent written and verbal English skills are mandatory.
· Mandarin and Cantonese language skills strongly preferred.
· Willingness and ability to travel regularly throughout China and Asia
>
Why This Role Matters
The Quality & Compliance Manager will play a critical role in ensuring HydraPak products are safe, high quality, globally compliant, and supported by the appropriate testing and documentation. This position will help build a proactive compliance program that identifies regulatory and quality risks before they become product or commercial issues.

About the Role

Customer-oriented use case design
Design and execute test scenarios that mirror real customer conversations—interruptions, overlapping speech, background noise, accents, off-script digressions, and edge-of-spectrum user behavior.

Non-functional requirements testing

Evaluate and quantify core experience metrics - ASR recognition accuracy, TTS naturalness, end-to-end latency, and drive issues to closure with engineering.
Quality infrastructure & observability
Establish end-to-end logging and tracing across the conversation pipeline to speed up root-cause analysis and reduce time-to-diagnosis.
Build maintainable automated test frameworks (Python/Java) integrated into CI/CD, covering both functional and non-functional scenarios.
Define, track, and report quality metrics; make release quality visible and data-driven for stakeholders.
Requirements
4+ years of QA/testing experience, ideally with voice, AI, or real-time communication products.
Proficient with Python or Java, experienced in building automated test frameworks—not just writing scripts, but engineering test infrastructure.
Deep quality mindset with a talent for uncovering boundary conditions and failure scenarios others miss.
Patience and rigor for detailed manual exploratory testing—genuine care for product detail and consistency.
Ability to work independently as the dedicated QA owner of a complex product, collaborating closely with engineering and product teams.

Experience testing VoIP, WebRTC, or other real-time network protocols.

Job Description
Factory Quality Inspector (Field)
Role Overview
The Factory Quality Inspector will be responsible for on-site and remote quality assurance of supplier factories. This role will involve regular travel to factories in mainland China (from Hong Kong), performing audits, inspections, training, and working with factories and third‐party inspectors to ensure consistent quality, preventive corrective actions, and vendor onboarding. The person in this role will help raise the quality bar across the Brand ID supplier base, reduce defects, support factory process improvements, and ensure products meet your standards and customer requirements.

Facilitate / coordinate with third‐party inspectors when needed (scoping, oversight, verification).
Maintain, analyze, and report on field inspection performance and outcomes (data metrics, defect rates, trends).
Train factory staff about our quality standards, including standard operating procedures, inspection methods, measurement, etc.
Support supplier/vendor onboarding assessments (capability audits, readiness, systems, quality processes).
Conduct production audits, pre‐shipment inspections/checks, and vendor quality capability assessments.
Travel regularly to factory sites in mainland China; conduct in‐person inspections, and build relationships with factory quality teams.
Document findings, prepare reports, and follow through to ensure corrective actions are implemented and verified.
Need to perform the in-house inspection at our facilities when needed.

Bachelor’s degree in textile/apparel technology, engineering, quality management, industrial engineering, or related field. (Equivalent experience may substitute.)

Strong knowledge of apparel/trim production processes and common quality issues; comfort with both soft goods and accessory/trim components.
Experience with third‐party inspections; knowledge of major inspection criteria, standards, statistical sampling, defect classification.
Good analytical skills; able to collect, analyze data, spot trends, propose preventive measures.
Strong communication skills; able to train and interact with diverse teams (factory staff, vendors, inspectors). Proficiency in Mandarin (or dialects used in factory regions) is highly preferred; Cantonese and English also helpful.
Self-motivated, detail oriented, with strong organizational skills.

jd:
The Product Engineer for Two-Way Radio Platforms supports the senior project engineers by serving as a local technical interface for two-way radio products in Hong Kong. This role helps ensure ODM/JDM designs meet Cedar’s RF performance, regulatory, product, and manufacturing readiness requirements by reviewing vendor-provided data, performing hands-on validation of new hardware and firmware releases, supporting factory engineering teams in resolving production issues when needed, and preparing clear test results and recommendations for final review and approval by Cedar’s Chicago-based engineering team.
Qualifications
>1) BS in Electrical Engineering or equivalent (or comparable RF/wireless product development experience).
>2) 2+ years of experience with radio products (e.g FRS/GMRS radios, Marine radios, DMR or other digital radio platforms, other wireless communication devices)
>3) Experience in RF communication systems, wireless devices, or two-way radio platforms, with demonstrated experience supporting requirements review, validation, and product readiness activities.
>4) Experience performing RF validation and interpreting results (e.g., sensitivity, selectivity, adjacent channel rejection, and related receiver/transmitter performance measures).
>5) Familiarity with Bluetooth integration in wireless devices (architecture, product requirements, test considerations, and common failure modes).
>6) Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English & Mandarin, with the ability to document technical findings clearly and translate complex RF, product, and test-related details into actionable guidance for cross-functional teams.
>7) Able to travel internationally between U.S., China and other APAC areas .
Preferred:
>1) Active Amateur Radio experience (or comparable hands-on radio hobbyist experience) & knowledge of analog and digital modulation techniques (e.g., FM, FSK, TDMA, or similar)
>2) Experience with audio/acoustic validation tools and workflows (e.g., Listen or similar systems).
>3) Experience with common hardware interfaces used in embedded/wireless products (e.g., UART, SPI, I²C, and related serial interfaces).
>4) Experience supporting wireless regulatory certification (FCC, CE, and/or related compliance standards), including working with external test labs and preparing/maintaining technical documentation.
>5) Experience working with external engineering/manufacturing partners (ODM/JDM/CM), including communicating requirements, reviewing evidence, and driving issue closure.
Essential Functions
>1) Support the senior project engineers as a local technical liaison with ODM/JDM partners: review designs, test data, and technical tradeoffs; identify risks; and help coordinate closure on issues impacting performance, quality, cost, or schedule.
>2) Plan and execute RF validation to confirm conformance to specifications, including (as applicable) receiver sensitivity, selectivity, adjacent channel rejection, blocking/intermod performance, and audio/acoustic performance.
>3) Support conducted and radiated testing and collaborate with partners and test labs to ensure robust pre-compliance and compliance readiness.
>4) Support wireless regulatory certification activities and documentation, including FCC and CE compliance (and other region-specific requirements as needed), and coordinate technical input across internal stakeholders and external labs/partners.
>5) Collect, analyze, and document test results from internal lab work, field testing, and vendor reports; provide clear summaries and recommendations to drive decisions.
>6) Provide technical input to the Senior Project Engineering team and product management as needed, including feature feasibility, design-for-test considerations, UI/UX implementation feedback, and early risk identification based on ODM/JDM design reviews and validation results.
>7) Support quality and manufacturing readiness by helping define QC procedures (QCP), factory test approaches, and repeatable acceptance criteria tied to product requirements.
>8) Use lab equipment effectively (service monitor, spectrum analyzer, RF signal generator, oscilloscope, DMM, etc.) to validate performance and troubleshoot issues with partners and internal teams.
>9) Support legacy product sustainment as needed—root cause analysis, issue reproduction, corrective actions, and validation of fixes.

Job Duties:
1. Privacy Legal Advisory & Regulatory Compliance
Provide day-to-day privacy and data protection advice to business and functional teams on personal data handling activities, new initiatives, technology deployments, and operational processes.

Assist with privacy reviews of contracts, vendor arrangements, outsourcing initiatives, data sharing arrangements, and cross-border data transfer activities.
Conduct or support Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Transfer Impact Assessments (TIAs), Legitimate Interest Assessments (LIAs), and related privacy reviews.
Monitor regulatory developments and emerging privacy risks and assist with updating policies, standards, guidance, and training materials.

Support the GPDO in the review of internal privacy and data protection policies, standards, guidelines, and procedures, in consultation with key stakeholders across the business, support units, and control functions (including Internal Audit);
Assist in the implementation of privacy compliance mechanisms for HKEX at a group level and coordinate privacy enhancement initiatives, remediation programmes, and implementation projects across the Group.
Support business and functional teams in embedding privacy-by-design and privacy-by-default principles into projects, systems, and operational processes.

Drive consistency of processes across workstreams that impact privacy and data protection risk.
Support internal audits, regulatory reviews, and assurance activities relating to privacy and data protection.

Act as a trusted privacy advisor to divisional stakeholders and privacy representatives.
Support governance forums, working groups, and management reporting.
Deliver privacy awareness and training initiatives across the Group.
Promote a culture of accountability and responsible personal data handling.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
location: Lai Chi Kok, Sham Shui Po District
teaser:
- Test-Driven Development (TDD) 

- Integration and API testing

- Experience in codebase

- Mentoring on a small QA

- Hands-on QA experience with AI
jd:
Job Summary
We are hiring a Senior QA Engineer to raise the quality bar on our software—not just by finding bugs at the end, but by embedding testing into how we build. You will write and own unit tests with developers, review test plans before work is treated as done, and hold the team to real coverage, not vanity metrics. This role is for someone who has already done this in a production codebase and can lead the practice, not only execute tickets.
Key Responsibilities
- Write, maintain, and raise the standard of unit tests across the codebase; pair with developers when needed and take ownership when tests are missing or weak.
- Review test plans and test cases before implementation and before release. Challenge incomplete scenarios, missing edge cases, and untestable requirements.
- Define and track coverage targets (unit and relevant integration layers). Report gaps by risk, not only by percentage.
- Review pull requests for test quality: missing tests, brittle assertions, untested branches, and coverage regressions.
- Set quality gates in CI so merges and releases cannot proceed when critical tests fail or coverage drops below agreed thresholds.
- Distinguish flaky tests from real failures; fix or quarantine flakiness so the suite stays trustworthy.
- Work with engineering leads on test strategy: what belongs in unit tests vs integration/API/E2E, and where coverage investment pays off.
- Mentor junior testers or developers on how to write useful tests and how to read a coverage report.
- Document defects with enough context to fix them, then verify the fix and the surrounding regression risk.
Required Skills and Qualifications
- 3+ years in a QA Engineer, SDET, or similar role on software products (not only manual UAT or checklist testing).
- Proven experience writing unit tests in a production codebase using Java, Python, or a comparable language (JUnit, TestNG, pytest, or equivalent).
- Experience reviewing test plans and saying what is missing—scope, data, failure modes, and exit criteria.
- Hands-on use of coverage tools and the judgment to interpret line/branch coverage vs meaningful scenario coverage.
- Solid Git workflow and CI/CD experience (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar); tests must run on every change.
- Ability to read application code well enough to design tests and review others’ tests.
- Clear, direct communication with engineers: review comments, coverage reports, and go/no-go input.
- Comfortable pushing back when a feature is under-tested or a plan is too thin.
Nice to have
- Test-Driven Development (TDD) or strong “tests with the code, not after the code” practice.
- Integration and API testing on top of unit tests (REST Assured, pytest + requests, Postman/Newman, or similar).
- Experience introducing or tightening coverage gates on an existing codebase.
- Mentoring or tech-lead experience on a small QA or engineering squad.
- Hands-on QA experience with AI: testing LLM/RAG or AI-assisted features, evaluating model output quality, or using AI tools to write, review, or maintain tests.
What We Offer
- Ownership of unit-test quality, test-plan review, and coverage—not a ticket queue of last-mile checks.
- Close partnership with development, with authority to block weak tests and weak plans.
- Room to shape process, tooling, and standards.
- Competitive salary and benefits.
Application questions
- How many years’ experience do you have in a QA / SDET / test engineering role?
- How many years’ experience do you have in the IT industry?
- Have you written and maintained unit tests in a production codebase? Which language and framework?
- Have you reviewed test plans and coverage reports and required changes before release?
- Do you have experience with Test-Driven Development (TDD)?
- What is your expected monthly basic salary?
- Which programming languages are you experienced in?

jd:
ABOUT MRDI
Hong Kong Microelectronics Research and Development Institute (MRDI) is established to seize the huge potential market for third-generation semiconductors and align with the national strategy for technological development. 香港微電子研究發展院 (MRDI) 的成立旨在把握第三代半導體的巨大潛在市場，並與國家科技發展戰略保持一致。

MRDI的願景是發揮領導作用，加強與業界、學術界及科研界的合作，加快科研成果的「1至N」轉化，推動技術創新，協助業界提升效率，並實現升級與轉型。
ABOUT THE ROLE
MRDI is inviting a capable and high-calibre professional to join the team as Engineer, Failure Analysis (FA) , responsible for failure analysis of semiconductor devices, including sample preparation, analysis execution, and root cause investigation. MRDI 現誠邀具能力及高質素的專業人士加入，擔任失效分析工程師 ，負責半導體失效分析工作，包括樣品製備、分析執行及根因分析等。

Responsible for receiving, logging, and managing failure analysis samples and workflow. 負責失效樣品的接收、登記及分析流程管理。
Perform sample preparation for failure analysis, including cutting, grinding, polishing, and related processes. 負責失效樣品製備，包括切割、研磨、拋光等前處理工藝。
Operate FIB, SEM, EDX and related tools to perform hands-on failure analysis (on-tool). 熟練操作FIB、SEM、EDX等分析設備，執行失效分析工作（hands-on, on-tool）。
Conduct structural characterisation, material analysis, and defect localisation. 負責分析過程中的結構觀察、成分分析及缺陷定位。
Analyse failure mechanisms and provide preliminary conclusions. 負責失效機理分析及初步結論輸出。
Support cross-functional root cause analysis with Process, WAT, PIE and other teams. 支援跨部門問題分析，與工藝、WAT、PIE等團隊協同開展root cause分析。
Prepare failure analysis reports, consolidate data, and archive analysis results. 編寫分析報告，整理數據並歸檔分析結果。
Maintain, manage, and calibrate FA laboratory equipment. 負責FA實驗室設備的日常維護、管理及校準。
Maintain workplace organisation (6S) and manage tools and consumables in the FA laboratory. 負責FA區域的6S管理、工具及耗材管理。
Assist in special analysis tasks and development of new failure analysis methodologies. 協助開展專項分析任務及新分析方法開發。
Provide administrative support and undertake ad hoc duties as assigned by the supervisor. 提供行政支援，並執行主管指派的其他臨時工作。

A Bachelor’s degree or above in Microelectronics, Materials Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering, or related disciplines. 持有微電子、材料、物理、電子工程或相關專業學士學位或以上學歷。

Familiar with semiconductor device structures and common failure mechanisms. 熟悉半導體器件結構及常見失效機理。
Strong analytical, problem-solving and root cause investigation skills. 具備良好的問題分析及根因分析能力。
Good report writing and data consolidation skills. 具備良好的報告撰寫能力及數據整理能力。
Good communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively across different functional teams. 具良好溝通及團隊合作能力，能與不同職能團隊有效協作。

jd:
Job Purpose
>
>This role is responsible for leading and coordinating institute-wide quality assurance and project initiatives under the Corporate Office, reporting directly to the CEO. The incumbent ensures robust governance, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement across all operational areas, including accreditation, policy management, service standards, and feedback systems. Acting as an independent quality assurance function, the role oversees investigations, drives enhancement initiatives, and promotes a strong quality culture across the Institute. Through objective analysis, cross-departmental collaboration, and strategic recommendations, the position supports management decision-making and safeguards the consistent delivery of high-quality programmes, products, and services.
>Job Duties
Quality Assurance Strategy & Governance
Lead the design, implementation, and continuous enhancement of Institute-wide quality assurance (QA) frameworks, policies, and systems to ensure consistent delivery of high-quality programmes, products, and services.
Provide independent oversight on all QA matters, to ensure alignment with governance standards and regulatory expectations.
Drive cross-functional collaboration in the development, review, and maintenance of policies, procedures, and guidelines.
Manage the annual Institute-wide document review process to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with established standards.
>
Accreditation & Regulatory Compliance
Serve as the primary liaison with government and regulatory authorities (e.g., QFS, HKCAAVQ), leading all accreditation exercises and annual compliance submissions.
Ensure all QA systems, documentation, and processes meet applicable regulatory and accreditation requirements.
>
>
Service Quality & Continuous Improvement
Establish Institute-wide service standards and oversee the implementation and monitoring of service pledges across Professional Qualification Programme (PQP), Continuous Professional Development activities (CPD), Membership, Events, and other services.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives by partnering with departments to enhance the quality, efficiency, and consistency of service delivery.
Conduct independent investigations into complaints, adverse feedback, and operational issues, ensuring objectivity and rigor.
Consolidate insights from investigations and feedback, translating them into actionable recommendations for management decision-making and service enhancement.
>
>
Feedback Management & Insights
Oversee the Institute’s feedback management framework, including the systematic collection, analysis, and reporting of stakeholder feedback.
Provide regular, insight-driven reports to management to inform strategic improvements and quality enhancement priorities.
>
>
Staff Capability Building & QA Culture
Develop and implement structured staff development initiatives including training, workshops, and knowledge-sharing to build QA awareness and competencies across the Institute.
Partner with department heads to embed QA principles and competencies into performance expectations and daily operations, promoting “quality in the flow of work.”
Translate quality insights, audit findings, and lessons learned into targeted learning interventions to drive continuous capability uplift.
Define and monitor QA-related competency indicators, identifying capability gaps and recommending development priorities.
Champion a culture of continuous learning by promoting best practices, benchmarking, and sharing of QA success stories across teams.
>
>
Documentation & Operational Excellence
>
Ensure all Institute documentation is developed, maintained, and reviewed to high standards of quality, accuracy, and compliance.
Oversee QA-related documentation and systems supporting capacity building and organisational development initiatives.
>
>
Other Responsibilities
Undertake ad hoc projects and assignments as delegated by the CEO and senior management.
Monitor and drive the implementation of continuous enhancement initiatives by relevant departments to improve the quality of products and services delivered, particularly in PQP, CPD, Events, and Membership services.
Manage and coordinate the Institute-wide annual document review process, ensuring timely completion, compliance with established standards, and alignment with governance requirements.
Oversee the development and maintenance of quality assurance systems and policies related to capacity building initiatives at the Institute level.
Manage and coordinate with departments to ensure all documentation is prepared and maintained to high standards of accuracy, quality, and compliance.
Undertake and deliver ad hoc projects and assignments as delegated by the CEO and senior management.
>
Job Requirements
Bachelor’s degree or above in a relevant discipline.
Minimum 8 years of relevant work experience, preferably in education, administration, compliance, the banking/financial services sector, or regulatory bodies, with demonstrated exposure to quality assurance or governance functions.
Strong quality assurance and compliance mindset, with a solid understanding of governance and control frameworks.
Proven project management capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and deliver results in a structured and timely manner.
Detail-oriented, self-motivated, and able to multitask effectively; a fast learner with a proactive attitude and strong sense of accountability.
Strong team collaboration skills, with the ability to work across functions and influence stakeholders.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with fluency in both written and spoken English and Chinese.
Proficient in standard business applications, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, and AI Tools.
Knowledge of HKQF and its implementation requirements
Familiarity with e-learning and Learning Management Systems (LMS) development is preferred.
Candidates with less experience and/or lower qualifications may be considered for appointment at the Assistant Manager level.

company: Kamui Cold Chain Engineering & Service Limited
title: E&M Engineer
teaser: Conduct site surveys, provide technical support for projects and overseeing, controlling the quality and progress of projects
bullet_points: Min 7 - 8 years of engineering experience in automation, E&M, smart warehousing
Proficiency in fixtures, jigs, custom lifting equipment

jd:
Kamui Cold Chain Engineering & Service Limited is a subsidiary of KAMUI Group, a Hong Kong based group of companies that takes pride in providing high-quality construction and M&E services, and also warehouse solutions throughout the region which started the business since 2000. We offer a comprehensive range of services including project management, construction, and engineering services. It also specializes in logistics technology and provide warehouse operation equipment and end-to-end solutions.
As an E&M Engineer, you will be responsible for the full lifecycle of warehouse electrical, mechanical, and automation infrastructure project implementation. You will bridge the gap between technical design and field execution, managing demand surveys, system layout planning, tendering, on-site supervision, and final project acceptance. Your focus will be to ensure all mechanical and electrical structures and warehouse automation components are seamlessly integrated and optimally executed.
Job Description:
Automation Solution Design & Solution Planning: Conduct detailed site surveys and user-requirement investigations. Design warehouse automation infrastructure solutions encompassing racking layouts, mechanical conveyors and integrated HVAC and electrical lighting networks.
Technical Documentation: Draft detailed technical specifications for procurement and tendering. Author Technical Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), formulate comprehensive project budgets (covering equipment, consumables, maintenance, and labour), and lead technical evaluation panels.
On-site Project & Commissioning Management: Act as the primary technical supervisor on-site. Coordinate the installation, modification, and demolition of E&M equipment, material handling automated machinery (WCS/conveyor lines), fire sprinkler systems, and structural partitions.
Equipment Optimization & Maintenance Management: Develop preventive maintenance plans for critical plant and warehouse assets. Design structural enhancements (e.g., customized lifting gear/fixtures) and execute automated production/assembly line transformations to boost output and safety.
Vendor & Stakeholder Alignment: Collaborate with external contractors and suppliers. Liaise directly with corporate clients to resolve technical queries, align project milestones, and drive formal project sign-off and handover acceptance.
>
Job Requirement:
Higher Diploma or above in Automation Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or related discipline.
Minimum 7 - 8 years of proven engineering experience in industrial automation, E&M facility installation, or smart warehousing infrastructure.
Demonstrated experience managing multi-disciplinary warehouse projects (e.g., automated conveyor line implementation, large-scale facility relocation, or complex racking installations).
Strong experience in the development of warehouse automation facilities
Solid knowledge of warehouse automation or electrical layouts
Proficiency in mechanical and structural design concepts (such as fixtures, jigs, or custom lifting equipment).
Familiarity with WCS (Warehouse Control Systems), logistics warehouse automation and robotics is highly preferred.
Strong budget forecasting, control and monitoring of project efficiency capabilities (P&L mindset regarding equipment, maintenance, and site operations).
Excellent project management skills with the ability to lead on-site contractors under tight timelines.
Strong analytical skills and competencies to conduct feasibility studies and clarify technical issues for clients, with excellent organizational skills, interpersonal and communication skills, time management, and multitasking across multiple projects
Proficient in spoken and written English, Mandarin and Cantonese
>

title: 鋁合金壓鑄工程師
teaser:
1.具備扎實的理論基礎與較強的動手能力，能深入生產一線解決實際工藝問題。
2.具備良好的邏輯思維與數據分析能力，善於透過數據統計優化工藝方案。
bullet_points: 績效獎金(含工藝優化獎勵、良品率達標獎勵)＋專案獎金(新品量產獎勵)＋年終獎金
五險一金，帶薪年假，節日福利，高溫補貼，定期體檢
提供技術培訓，支持職稱評定，提供明確的職涯晉升通道
jd:
崗位職責
1. 工藝開發與優化
• 依據汽車零部件圖紙（如電機殼體、電池包支架、底盤轉向節等），獨立制定鋁合金壓鑄工藝方案，確定澆道／溢流槽／排氣系統設計方案及壓鑄參數（壓射壓力、速度、模具溫度、保壓時間）。
• 主導新品壓鑄工藝試模工作，跟蹤試模全過程，分析鑄件缺陷（氣孔、縮孔、冷隔、裂紋等），透過調整工藝參數、優化模具結構，使鑄件良品率達到目標標準（≥95%）。
• 針對量產階段的工藝瓶頸開展優化工作，降低原材料損耗（≤3%）、縮短生產節拍，提升整體產線效率。
2. 品質管控與體系落地
• 精通 IATF 16949 汽車行業品質管理體系，主導 APQP、PPAP、FMEA、SPC、MSA 等品質工具的應用，編制壓鑄工藝品質控制計畫，確保產品符合主機廠技術標準。
• 制定壓鑄件入廠檢驗、製程檢驗、出廠檢驗標準，並配合品質部處理客戶反饋的品質問題，提供工藝整改方案並跟蹤驗證。
• 建立壓鑄工藝參數資料庫，記錄關鍵工藝數據，為品質追溯提供技術支援。
3. 模具與設備管理
• 參與壓鑄模具設計評審，從工藝可行性角度提出改進建議，指導模具廠完成模具加工與調試，延長模具使用壽命（≥5 萬模次）。
• 熟悉冷室壓鑄機（力勁、伊之密、布勒等品牌）的性能參數，配合設備部完成設備日常維護、保養及故障排查，確保設備稼動率 ≥90%。
• 制定壓鑄模具保養計畫，指導車間操作員進行模具日常清潔、潤滑及易損件更換。
4. 技術文件編制與培訓
• 編制壓鑄工藝卡、作業指導書、模具維護手冊等技術文件，確保文件的準確性、完整性與可操作性。
• 對生產車間操作員、質檢員進行壓鑄工藝知識培訓，指導現場人員規範作業，提升一線員工的工藝執行能力。
• 跟蹤鋁合金壓鑄行業新技術（真空壓鑄、半固態壓鑄、高壓壓鑄）發展趨勢，引入先進工藝並推動落地應用。
5. 成本控制與團隊協作
• 根據產品特性選擇合適的鋁合金牌號（ADC12、A380、AlSi9Cu3 等），優化原材料配比，降低物料成本。
• 與研發、採購、製造、銷售等部門協同合作，參與新產品立項評審、供應商技術評審及客戶技術對接，確保專案順利推進。
核心技能
精通鋁合金壓鑄工藝原理，熟悉汽車零部件壓鑄工藝特點，具備獨立制定工藝方案與解決複雜工藝問題的能力。
能熟練使用 CAD、UG、Pro/E 等繪圖軟體繪製工藝圖紙，掌握金相分析、力學性能檢測等品質驗證方法。
熟悉各類壓鑄機及輔助設備的操作與調試，了解壓鑄模具結構設計與加工工藝，能獨立主導試模工作。
精通 IATF 16949 品質管理體系及五大品質工具的應用，能編制完整的工藝技術文件與品質控制計畫。
具備基礎英文閱讀能力，能讀懂英文壓鑄設備操作手冊及國際主機廠技術標準。
工作經驗
1.具備 3–5 年以上鋁合金壓鑄工藝或現場技術工作經驗，具備汽車零部件壓鑄行業背景者優先。
2.有新能源汽車零部件（如電機殼體、電池包支架等）壓鑄項目經驗者優先。
3.具備獨立主導壓鑄模具試模、量產轉序等專案的成功實施經驗。
學歷與專業
1.大專及以上學歷，材料成型及控制工程、金屬材料工程、機械設計製造及其自動化、壓鑄工藝等相關專業。
2.持有壓鑄工程師職業資格證書、IATF 16949 內審員證書、模具設計師證書者優先。
需駐守國內工廠，定期回香港總公司匯報。有興趣者

jd:
Reporting to the Assistant Academic Registrar (Academic Quality Advancement), the candidate plays a key role in advancing academic quality through quality assurance and enhancement initiatives, data analytics, systems development, governance support, and student engagement activities. The role contributes to evidence-based decision-making, continuous improvement of teaching and learning, and the effective delivery of institutional quality processes.
>
>
>
>We are seeking a proactive, experienced, adaptable, and self-motivated professional to join our team. The successful candidate will manage projects, deliver high-quality analytical and operational outputs, coordinate stakeholders, and support technology- and AI-enabled approaches to advancing academic quality. The role requires a positive, solutions-oriented mindset, strong project management capability, analytical rigor, professional judgment, effective communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic environment while responding flexibly to evolving priorities and operational needs. A strong commitment to accountability, ownership, quality, innovation, and continuous improvement is essential, together with the ability to work independently.
>
>
>
>Key Responsibilities
>
Maintain project plans, timelines, workflows, procedures, and user manuals for surveys, evaluations, annual reporting, review exercises, and other quality-related activities.
Coordinate surveys, projects, initiatives, and operational activities, ensuring effective planning, stakeholder engagement, risk management, governance compliance, and timely delivery.
Manage the collection, validation, cleansing, integration, and analysis of student survey results, institutional datasets, and quality-related information, ensuring data quality, integrity, reliability, validity, consistency, and fitness for purpose.
Conduct statistical analysis, benchmarking, performance reporting, dashboard development, and evidence generation to support institutional reporting, management insight, and informed decision-making.
Prepare analytical reports, presentations, committee papers, management reports, briefing materials, and evidence-based recommendations for senior management, committees, academic units, and other stakeholders.
Support academic quality initiatives, student partnership, advocacy, and engagement activities to strengthen the student voice, promote the effective use of student feedback, and foster a culture of continuous improvement and excellence across the University community.
Support the development, implementation, enhancement, and adoption of systems, dashboards, analytics tools, automation initiatives, and AI-enabled solutions to strengthen operational effectiveness and efficiency, reporting capabilities, user experience, and evidence-based decision-making.
Apply data analytics, statistical, business intelligence, and programming tools (e.g., Python, SQL, R, SPSS, Power BI, Tableau, and Qlik Sense) to deliver valuable insights, improve processes, streamline workflows, develop dashboards and visualizations, enhance reporting and automation capabilities, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
Maintain documentation, records, audit trails, standard operating procedures, and knowledge repositories to support accountability, governance, continuity, and sustainable operations.
Perform any other duties and responsibilities as assigned.
>
>Qualifications and Experience
>
A recognised bachelor's degree with at least two years of relevant post-qualification experience in higher education, academic administration, quality assurance, quality enhancement, institutional research, data analytics, survey research, project management, governance support, or related fields. Qualifications in Statistics, Data Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Social Sciences, Educational Research, or related disciplines would be advantageous.
Depending on qualifications and relevant experience, applicants may be considered for appointment as Assistant Manager or Officer.
Proven track record in project management, survey administration, data analytics, reporting, governance support, committee servicing, quality assurance activities, quality enhancement initiatives, or institutional improvement projects.
Ability to analyse and interpret quantitative and qualitative data, apply sound analytical judgment and critical thinking, and translate findings into actionable insights, recommendations, and management information for diverse stakeholders.
Proven ability to coordinate multiple projects and stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and deliver outcomes effectively under tight timelines through strong organisational, planning, and time management skills.
Familiarity with higher education quality assurance, quality enhancement, institutional research, student surveys, programme review, accreditation, or related activities would be advantageous.
Exposure to data management, statistical analysis, dashboard development, business intelligence, institutional reporting, or evidence-based decision-making would be highly desirable.
>
>Knowledge, Skills and Competencies
>
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Chinese (Cantonese and Mandarin), with proven ability in report writing, presentation development, editing, facilitation, and stakeholder engagement.
Well-developed analytical, critical thinking, problem-solving, project management, planning, coordination, prioritisation and organisational capabilities.
Sound professional judgment coupled with attention to detail, integrity, accountability, ownership, and commitment to accuracy, quality and follow-through.
Experience in data management and analytics, including data validation, quality assurance, information integrity management, statistical analysis, survey analytics, data modelling, benchmarking, performance reporting, data visualisation, dashboard development, and evidence generation.
High proficiency in one or more analytics, statistical, business intelligence, visualisation, or programming tools, such as Python, SQL, R, SPSS, Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense, and related dashboard development technologies.
Practical experience in applying automation, AI-assisted analytics, reporting solutions, or other technology-enabled approaches to enhance operational effectiveness would be an advantage.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively, engage effectively with diverse stakeholders, and manage multiple priorities under tight timelines.
Positive attitude, growth mindset, adaptability, resilience, flexibility, service orientation, and commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
Strong commitment to accountability, ownership, quality, innovation, continuous improvement, and the delivery of sustainable and impactful outcomes.

Design and ship agentic products end-to-end — from problem definition and workflow design to prototyping, production, and iteration

High agency and ownership — you investigate, make decisions, build, ship, measure, and iterate
We care much more about what you've actually built and how you think than whether your previous title was Product Manager, Engineer, or Founder.

YC-backed, early stage — what you build ships and matters immediately
Agentic workflows are core to the product , not an AI feature bolted on top
Small team, high trust, direct access to founders
Real ownership over product direction, architecture, and execution
Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy environment where good ideas can go from conversation to production quickly

Own the integrated T&C programme. Develop and maintain the resource-loaded master programme, four-week look-ahead, weekly test schedule and short-term readiness plan, ensuring alignment with actual site progress, approved submissions, logical predecessors, stakeholder availability and contractual milestones.
Drive recovery and mitigation. Identify critical-path slippage, interface conflicts and mutually exclusive test windows. Issue quantified recovery plans covering additional resources, resequencing, extended working hours and revised completion dates. Incomplete tests shall be formally rescheduled and not simply removed from the programme.
Control technical submissions. Establish and maintain the T&C deliverables register covering the Commissioning Plan, Method Statements, Risk Assessments, ITPs, test scripts, self-test records, RIO forms, Cause & Effect Matrix, Sequence of Operation, set-point schedules, interface matrices and final reports. No witnessed test shall proceed unless installation, approved documents, safety controls, calibrated instruments, self-test records, utilities, load banks, controls, vendors and required witnesses are confirmed available.
Manage the full L1–L5 commissioning process. Coordinate FAT/SAT, installation verification, start-up, pre-functional testing, functional performance testing, heat load testing, Mini-IST/IST, TCCF demonstration and reliability runs. Ensure the correct sequence and closure of prerequisite tests and critical defects before progressing to the next level.

工藝與成本優化： 評估現有產品結構與配件的優劣，研究並引入新技術、新工藝、新材料，提出降低成本（Cost-down）或提升裝配效益的方案。
團隊與供應商協作： 負責管理研發團隊的事務，為設計、生產、品質等部門提供技術支援，並與相關部門及供應商保持高效溝通配合。
>
要求

管理經驗： 具傋管理及項目統籌實際經驗，能帶領團隊提升進步的能力。
學歷要求： 機械工程、產品工程、鐘錶製造或相關專業大專或以上學歷（具備工程背景優先）。
繪圖軟件： 精通 AutoCAD (2D) 及 SolidWorks / Pro-E / CATIA (3D) 等工業級工程繪圖與結構造型軟件。
專業知識： 精通手錶開發工程結構，熟悉機芯、錶殼、錶帶、錶針、錶盤、錶的（冠）的功能檢驗、組裝配合及製作工藝要求。
核心能力： 具備獨立解決生產線技術問題的能力，工作細心，抗壓能力強。
工作地點： 須長駐深圳廠房，或按需要出差
語言能力： 具備流利的英語、粵語及普通話聽說讀寫能力。
>
Responsibilities
New Product Introduction (NPI): Lead the technical development of new watch products; convert conceptual design layouts into mass-production ready engineering drawings and physical prototypes.
Feasibility Assessment: Review 2D/3D engineering drawings and assess watch structure and movement feasibility to ensure compliance with production standards.
Prototyping & Trial Production: Oversee watch sampling, prototyping, and small-batch trial production; monitor component quality, track timelines, and document assembly abnormalities.
Technical Troubleshooting: Resolve technical issues regarding watch structure, high-precision materials, water resistance, and assembly processes; provide on-site technical support.
Defect Analysis & Complaints: Coordinate customer product complaints and conduct in-depth analysis on production line defects (e.g., timing inaccuracies, scratches, looseness); deliver root-cause analysis and improvements.
Process & Cost Optimization: Evaluate current product structures and components; research and introduce new horological technologies, materials, or processes to drive cost-down and efficiency.
Team & Supplier Collaboration: Manage daily operations of the R&D team; provide technical support to Design, Production, and Quality departments, and collaborate efficiently with suppliers.

Requirements

Managerial Experience: Proven experience in team management and project coordination, with a strong ability to lead and develop a team.
Education: Diploma / Degree or above in Mechanical Engineering, Product Engineering, Watchmaking, or related disciplines (Engineering background preferred).
Software Skills: Proficient in AutoCAD (2D) and SolidWorks / Pro-E / CATIA (3D) for engineering drawing and structural modeling.
Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of watch engineering structures; familiar with movements, cases, straps, hands, dials, and crowns regarding inspection, fitment, and manufacturing processes.
Core Competencies: Proven ability to troubleshoot production line technical issues independently; highly detail-oriented with strong stress tolerance.
Work Location: Must be permanently stationed at the Shenzhen factory, with travel as required.
Languages: Fluent in spoken and written English, Cantonese, and Mandarin.

COMPANY OVERVIEW
We are a long-established Hong Kong-based manufacturer and exporter with a major production base in Dongguan.
The company specializes in lighting products and consumer electrical products, and has strong OEM/ODM capability.
The company has a large factory operation, strong manufacturing know-how, and internal product development and testing capabilities.

ROLE MISSION
Lead the R&D function and drive new product development for the company’s lighting and consumer electrical product lines.
Improve product design, performance, quality, and cost effectiveness.
Support the factory and commercial teams in bringing new products from concept to production.

This is a hands-on R&D leadership role based in the Dongguan factory.

The role will cover new product development, technical improvement, prototype testing, and project coordination.

Lead and supervise the R&D team in Dongguan.
Develop new products and improve existing products for lighting and consumer electrical categories.
Manage product concept development, prototype creation, testing, and launch preparation.
Work closely with the factory on design feasibility, production process, and material selection.
Review product specifications, safety requirements, quality standards, and cost targets.
Support OEM/ODM customer projects and product customization requests.
Cooperate with quality, production, procurement, and sales teams throughout the development process.
Monitor market trends and identify new product opportunities.
Liaise with suppliers and technical partners as needed.
Ensure product development projects are completed on time and within budget.
IDEAL CANDIDATE
Degree in Engineering preferably Electrical or Electronic Engineering, or a related discipline.
Strong R&D or product development experience in a manufacturing environment.
Experience in lighting products or consumer electrical products is highly preferred.
Good technical knowledge of product design, testing, materials, and manufacturing processes.
Strong project management and problem-solving skills.
Able to lead a team and work well with cross-functional departments.

Job Summary
The Quality Assurance Manager is responsible for managing CQ’s food safety and quality assurance systems and overseeing the daily operations of the QA/QC Department. The role ensures that all products, manufacturing activities and facilities comply with applicable food safety legislation, licensing requirements, company standards and certification requirements, including FSSC 22000 and ISO 22000.
The successful candidate will also participate in new product development, factory licensing applications, supplier and product compliance reviews, internal audits and continuous improvement initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Food Safety Management Systems
Maintain, implement and continuously improve the company’s FSSC 22000, ISO 22000, HACCP, GMP and related food safety management systems.
Ensure that policies, procedures, SOPs, work instructions and records are properly established, implemented and maintained.
Coordinate internal audits, management reviews, risk assessments and corrective and preventive actions.
Prepare for and coordinate external certification, customer and regulatory audits.
Follow up on audit findings and ensure corrective actions are completed within the required timeframe.
Monitor changes in relevant food safety regulations, standards and certification requirements.
QA/QC Department Management
Lead and oversee the daily operations of the QA/QC Department.
Supervise, train and develop QA/QC team members.
Establish inspection, testing, sampling and monitoring programmes for raw materials, work-in-progress products, finished products and the production environment.
Review QA/QC/PD records, inspection results and laboratory testing reports.
Ensure that non-conforming materials and products are properly identified, segregated, investigated and handled.
Monitor hygiene, sanitation, pest control, allergen control, foreign-object control and environmental conditions within the factory.
Conduct regular factory inspections and verify compliance with GMP and internal standards.
Regulatory Compliance and Factory Licensing
Handle food factory licence applications, renewals, amendments and related regulatory submissions.
Liaise with relevant government departments, certification bodies, laboratories, consultants and external service providers.
Ensure that the factory, production processes and documentation comply with applicable Hong Kong food safety and licensing requirements.
New Product Development
Participate in new product development projects from the food safety, quality and regulatory perspectives.
Review product formulations, raw material specifications, allergen information, production processes, shelf-life requirements and packaging specifications.
Conduct or coordinate product risk assessments, trial production reviews, shelf-life studies and product testing.
Review product labels and claims to ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.
Approve new raw materials, suppliers, packaging materials and finished-product specifications before commercial production.
>
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Food Safety, Microbiology, Chemistry or a related discipline.
At least 3 years of relevant experience in the food manufacturing or food processing industry.
Practical experience in implementing or maintaining FSSC 22000, ISO 22000, HACCP or other recognised food safety management systems.
Experience in managing factory audits, certification audits and regulatory inspections.
Knowledge of Hong Kong food safety legislation, food labelling requirements and food factory licensing procedures.
Good leadership, communication, problem-solving and analytical skills.
Strong attention to detail with good documentation and record-management skills.
Able to work independently and coordinate effectively with Production, R&D, Purchasing, Warehouse, Retail, Marketing and other departments.
Good command of written and spoken Cantonese and English, proficiency in Putonghua.

jd:
About Modernspace

We combine design, logistics, and project management to help leading global brands shape their physical spaces.

About the Role
Due to the expansion of our operations and the rollout of a new Odoo ERP environment, we are strengthening our global IT team. An external partner will design and build the platform — and we are looking for an internal expert who advises on that building, independently verifies what the supplier delivers, and then owns the environment for the long term. This is a unique opportunity to take ownership and make a direct impact at one of the fastest-growing manufacturing scale-ups in the market, working closely with teams across Europe, the US, and Asia.
As a hands-on Odoo ERP Engineer, you serve as the bridge between our business, our IT team, and our implementation partner. In the building phase, you are our trusted advisor and quality gate; afterward, you become the functional engineer who maintains and continuously improves the platform as the business evolves.
You enjoy solving complex problems, you are comfortable challenging a supplier on technical and functional decisions, and you can translate business needs into well-designed ERP processes.
Key Responsibilities:
ERP Advisory & Vendor Oversight
Act as the internal subject-matter expert advising the IT team and the business throughout the third-party Odoo implementation.
Review and challenge the supplier’s functional designs, technical architecture, and data model decisions before they are built.
Define clear acceptance criteria and independently verify that delivered modules, customizations, and integrations meet quality, security, and performance standards.
Validate data migration completeness and integrity from existing systems into Odoo.
Odoo Functional Engineering
Translate business requirements (sales, purchasing, inventory, manufacturing/MRP, accounting, projects) into well-configured Odoo processes.
Configure modules, workflows, and reports; design and document target business processes together with key users (low-code solutions).
Own the backlog of functional improvements and prioritize by business value once the platform is live.
Odoo Technical Engineering
Read and assess custom Odoo code (Python, the ORM, QWeb, XML views) to judge supplier deliverables and to build improvements yourself where appropriate.
Develop and maintain custom modules, server actions, automated rules, and reports.
Build and maintain integrations between Odoo and other business systems via the Odoo API and middleware.
Integration, Data & Maintenance
Integrate Odoo with the Microsoft 365 ecosystem (SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID) and other line-of-business systems.
Manage upgrades across supported Odoo versions, performance tuning, monitoring, and backups.
Provide third-line support and act as an escalation point for ERP incidents.
Security, Governance & Documentation
Apply best practices for access control, data privacy, auditability, and segregation of duties, aligned with our ISO 27001 framework.
Maintain clear documentation, configuration records, and improvement roadmaps.
Train and enable internal teams and key users to work effectively in Odoo.
Requirements:
Hands-on experience implementing, configuring, and maintaining Odoo across one or more recent supported versions (17 / 18 / 19), in Community and/or Enterprise editions.
Solid Odoo functional knowledge across core ERP domains (sales, purchasing, inventory, manufacturing/MRP, accounting).
Technical Odoo skills: Python, the Odoo ORM, QWeb, XML views, and the OWL framework; ability to read and review custom modules.
Experience with API-based integrations and ERP data migration.
Strong SQL / PostgreSQL skills.
Experience reviewing or overseeing the work of an implementation partner, including defining acceptance criteria.
Ability to translate business needs into technical and functional ERP solutions.
Would be an advantage if you have:
Official Odoo certification.
Experience with Odoo.sh and/or on-premises Odoo deployment and version migration (e.g., Open Upgrade).
Knowledge of xTuple ERP (manufacturing/distribution; PostgreSQL-based).
Familiarity with the Microsoft 365 ecosystem (Teams, SharePoint, Entra ID).
Awareness of ISO 27001 / information-security principles in an ERP context.
Experience in a manufacturing or project-based organization.
Our onboarding starts with a warm welcome and an introduction to your team and workspace. In your first week, you’ll get familiar with our tools, processes, and company culture, and you’ll be assigned a mentor for your first few months. We make sure there’s a good balance between training, hands-on learning, and regular check-ins to help you settle in smoothly.

title: R&D Engineer - BIPV Systems (Hong Kong SAR)
teaser: Lead cutting-edge BIPV innovation. Competitive salary, professional development, exposure to high growth industry and expertise.
jd:
About us
>ClearVue Technologies Ltd is an innovative advanced building materials company headquartered in Perth, Western Australia. ClearVue specialises in advanced building integrated photovoltaic (BIPV) technologies for facade, curtain wall, skylight, balustrade and architectural glazing applications. We are committed to developing sustainable solutions that transform buildings into energy-generating assets by activating the building envelope and achieving excellent thermal control. Our mission is to lead the industry in creating intelligent, integrated solar technologies that combine energy generation, functionality, thermal performance and aesthetic design. We pride ourselves on our collaborative culture, multidisciplinary team, technical excellence, and dedication to pushing the boundaries of renewable energy innovation.
About the role
>We are seeking an R&D Project Engineer – BIPV System Integration to join our dynamic team. This is a full-time position based in Hong Kong SAR, with flexibility for candidates based in Perth, Western Australia. In this strategic role, you will be responsible for advancing our building integrated photovoltaic system integration capabilities through research, development, concept design, prototyping and practical implementation. You will work at the intersection of renewable energy technology and the built environment, contributing to projects that have a significant impact on sustainable building practices globally. This position offers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge solar technologies whilst collaborating with cross-functional teams to bring innovative BIPV solutions to market. The position requires regular travel to Mainland China and collaboration with our contract R&D providers, and OEMs, fluency in English, Mandarin and Cantonese is required for effective collaboration.
Invent and improve. Develop proprietary components at the heart of our products, thinking laterally about constraints others accept as fixed.
Concepts into briefs. Interrogate an early idea and utilise innovative and creative thinking to come up with solutions that break down the barriers to BIPV deployment. Write the engineering brief covering design intent, performance, constraints, interfaces, and applicable standards. Present options and solutions with advanced modelling, simulations, 3D component designs, working closely with senior leadership.
Design and modelling. Produce SolidWorks models of facade units and ClearVue components. Develop concepts through to fabrication drawings, GD&T, and bills of materials. Design for real manufacturing methods: extrusion, sheet metal, moulding, machining. Maintain the CAD library and revision control.
Electronics integration. Design bespoke components such as junction boxes, cabling, connectors, and inverters or optimisers to improve product performance. Understand string layout, connector selection, earthing, IP rating, and heat build up around power electronics and provide solutions to project teams.
Performance. Model energy yield for vertical and shaded facade conditions, not standard rooftop assumptions. Support glazing optical and thermal modelling, thermal bridging, and condensation risk. Support in energy generation modelling and develop tools and guidelines for project teams/sales teams.
Prototyping at OEM sites and R&D Partners. Plan builds with partners: scope, timing, materials, acceptance criteria. Produce the build pack. Record deviations and turn them into the next revision.
Project coordination. Hold the R&D schedule across internal, partner, and research work. Chase deliverables. Run partner meetings and close out actions. Keep the document and decision record. Report status, risk, and blockers. Track spend, manage prototype logistics and shipping, and support grant milestone reporting.
Certification and Compliance. Assist certification and standards work to IEC, ISO, UL, and AS including the fire test programme. Support the projects and sales teams on live installations.
Software
Essential: SolidWorks (parts, assemblies, drawings, sheet metal). AutoCAD or equivalent 2D DWG.
Advantageous: Revit, Rhino and Grasshopper. PV yield modelling (PVsyst, SAM, PV*SOL or Helioscope). SolidWorks Simulation. LTspice, Altium or KiCad. Python or MATLAB with pvlib. KeyShot or SolidWorks Visualize.
Detailed building thermal and facade modelling is done by specialist consultants. Conceptual understanding, ability to brief, interrogate what comes back, and design a product that performs is required.
Required
Degree in mechanical, mechatronic, electrical, materials engineering or similar technical field.
One to four years of electrical or mechanical design experience, R&D focus preferred.
Mechanical design fundamentals: tolerances, fits, fastening, material selection, sealing.
Solar PV knowledge. IV curves, string behaviour, bypass diodes, temperature and irradiance effects, shading losses.
Be able to interpret and review SLDs, facade detailed design drawings, electrical design and building engineering drawings.
Electronics literacy to design around components and hardware.
Strong written communication in English, Mandarin and Cantonese. Your briefs need to work for both our global team and a local factory engineer in China.
Organised and self directed across several parallel projects and able to work cross functionally with a multidisciplinary team.
Able to travel internationally to partner factories and project sites as required.
Desirable
We do not expect all of this. BIPV is a new field, specialist knowledge in this field can be taught.
Facade thermal knowledge: U value, SHGC, VLT, thermal bridging, condensation, cavity behaviour.
Architectural glazing: IGU construction, glass types, laminates, low E coatings, edge seals and spacers, curtain wall and unitised systems.
Standards familiarity: AS 1288, AS/NZS 4666, AS 2047, NCC Section J, AS/NZS 5033.
Grant funded or university research projects.
FEA or CFD, particularly structural glass or thermal.
Hands on prototyping experience.
Familiarity with the patenting process.
Experience with renewable energy systems, sustainable building technologies, solar or BIPV applications
Knowledge of thermal management, materials science, or structural integration as applied to building systems
Familiarity with regulatory and building standards in key markets (Hong Kong, Singapore, Australia, UK, USA)
What we offer
>ClearVue Technologies Ltd is committed to fostering a supportive and innovative work environment where your contributions are valued. We offer competitive remuneration aligned with experience and qualifications, comprehensive health and wellness benefits, and opportunities for continuous professional development. You will have access to leading industry experts, and the chance to work on projects that contribute to global sustainability goals. We support flexible working arrangements where appropriate and encourage a healthy work-life balance. Additionally, we provide pathways for career advancement, professional development funding, and mentorship from experienced team members. We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
Apply now
>If you are an accomplished engineering professional passionate about renewable energy and BIPV technologies, we would like to hear from you. Please submit your curriculum vitae, a cover letter outlining your relevant experience, and any supporting documents to our recruitment team. Join us in shaping the future of sustainable building technologies.

We are seeking a dynamic Principal Engineer to lead advanced control systems development, focusing on advanced control systems, your responsibilities will center on the technical design, optimization, and innovation of servo control technologies.
>
Job Responsibilities:
1. Advanced Control System Development:
Design and enhance high-performance control systems, including PID and MIMO (Multiple Input, Multiple Output) architectures for VCM, PZT, and motor controllers.
2. Simulation & Modeling:
Conduct comprehensive control and seek model simulations using MATLAB to define and optimize system parameters across various testing platforms.
3. Performance Tuning & Troubleshooting:
Analyze and fine-tune system parameters to maximize performance.
Resolve complex technical issues related to servo calibration, defect detection, and vibration compensation.
4. DSP Programming:
Review and optimize Digital Signal Processing (DSP) code to achieve faster response times and improve overall system efficiency.
5. Technical Innovation & Research:
Drive R&D initiatives to implement the latest servo control technologies.

title: Manager/Senior Electronic Engineer (Robotics)
teaser: Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Electronic Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline.
jd:
About Us
Primech AI is the robotics arm of Primech Holdings Limited (Nasdaq: PMEC), a Singapore-headquartered facilities management group with approximately 3,000 employees. We design and commercialise HYTRON, an autonomous washroom cleaning robot deployed across Asia, Europe, and the United States, with active partnerships spanning Japan, Korea, and the Netherlands. Our Hong Kong engineering team owns the core robotics software stack, from perception and navigation to system integration.
The Role
We are seeking an experienced Manager/Senior Electronic Engineer to lead the hardware development of our next-generation autonomous cleaning robots. In this role, you will own the full electrical hardware lifecycle—from initial concept architecture and high-power management to PCB layout, sensor integration, and international regulatory compliance (UL, FCC, CE). You will work closely with firmware, mechanical, and software teams to translate commercial cleaning requirements into robust, mass-production-ready hardware systems.
Responsibilities
• Hardware Architecture & System Design: Design and execute mainboard schematics, power distribution architecture, and multi-layer PCB layouts (using Altium, KiCAD, or equivalent) for autonomous robotic systems.
• Power Electronics & Battery Management: Lead the engineering and integration of high-voltage/high-capacity battery systems (e.g., 48V Li-ion packs), including custom BMS integration, DC-DC buck/boost converters, thermal safety, and fast-charging interfaces.
• Actuation & Motor Control: Select, integrate, and tune motor drives and controllers for traction, high-torque brush drives, water/vacuum pumps, and auxiliary actuators.
• Sensor Integration: Interface high-density sensor suites (LiDAR, ToF cameras, ultrasonic sensors, cliff detectors, and optical encoders) via standard communication buses (CAN, RS485, SPI, I2C, UART).
• Certification & Regulatory Compliance: Drive hardware design for compliance (DFM/DFT), leading the robot through global safety and EMC certifications including UL 1017 / UL 1973 / UL 2271, FCC Part 15 Class B, and CE/EMC.
• Prototyping, Testing & NPI: Build, debug, and validate hardware prototypes; establish test plans for Engineering Verification (EVT) and Design Verification (DVT); support transfer to mass production (NPI).
Requirements
• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Electronic Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related discipline.
• Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in electronic hardware design, preferably within robotics, automated machinery, IoT devices, or high-reliability electro-mechanical products.
• Proven track record in multi-layer PCB layout with strict signal integrity (SI) and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) considerations.
• Deep experience bringing complex hardware products through UL/FCC/CE testing and safety certification.
• Solid understanding of low-level embedded hardware interfaces and motor driver topology.
• Soft Skills & Mindset: Strong analytical problem-solving skills, proactive ownership, and experience collaborating with cross-functional software and mechanical teams.
• Languages: Proficiency in English and Cantonese/Mandarin (for supplier and factory communication).
Nice to Have
• Experience with wet/dry cleaning appliances, IP-rated enclosure requirements (e.g., IPX4–IPX7 water/dust proofing), or fluid pump management.
• Exposure to embedded microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32) or ROS/Linux-based robotic hardware platforms.
• Experience managing EMS/ODM manufacturing partners in the Greater Bay Area.
What We Offer
• Direct impact on a commercially deployed robotics product listed on Nasdaq
• Small, senior engineering team with fast decision-making and real ownership
• Exposure to international deployments (US, Japan, Korea, EU)
• Competitive salary, discretionary bonus, and medical benefits
How to Apply
Please submit your CV with current and expected salary. Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a technical interview at our Hong Kong office.

title: Electrical Engineer - Data Center Design
teaser: This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.
jd:
Role Overview
The company is launching a new brand focused on data center development and prefabricated product delivery. We are looking for an Electrical Engineer who can independently lead electrical design work for data center projects, supporting design development, technical review, tendering, prefabricated product delivery, and project implementation across overseas markets.
This role will serve as the electrical discipline owner across design and delivery interfaces, working closely with architecture, mechanical, structural, product, pre-sales, project delivery, vendors, and external consultants to ensure the electrical system is safe, reliable, scalable, and aligned with international data center standards.
>
Key Responsibilities
• Independently lead electrical design for data center projects, including concept design, schematic design, design development, technical coordination, and design review.
• Develop and review electrical system architecture covering utility intake, MV/LV distribution, transformers, switchgear, UPS, generators, PDUs/RPPs, grounding, lightning protection, and emergency power systems.
• Prepare and review electrical drawings, single-line diagrams, load calculations, capacity planning, equipment schedules, technical specifications, and design narratives.
• Support prefabricated data center product design by translating project requirements into standardized electrical modules, interfaces, factory testing requirements, and installation-ready deliverables.
• Coordinate with mechanical, structural, architectural, fire services, BMS/DCIM, and ICT disciplines to resolve cross-discipline design interfaces and spatial coordination issues.
• Provide technical support for pre-sales and tendering, including technical proposals, tender clarifications, customer meetings, value engineering, and technical risk assessments.
• Review vendor submissions, equipment selections, factory acceptance test requirements, and technical deviations to ensure compliance with project specifications and data center reliability requirements.
• Support project delivery teams during construction, commissioning, testing, issue resolution, and handover, ensuring design intent is maintained through implementation.
• Track international data center electrical standards, industry best practices, equipment trends, and regulatory requirements across target overseas markets.
Requirements & Qualifications
• Bachelor degree or above in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
• 5+ years of electrical design experience, with hands-on experience in data centers, mission-critical facilities, industrial facilities, or large-scale infrastructure projects.
• Proven ability to independently lead electrical discipline design for data center or mission-critical projects, from early-stage design through detailed design and delivery support.
• Strong knowledge of MV/LV power distribution, UPS, generators, switchgear, transformers, grounding, protection coordination, redundancy architecture, and electrical system reliability design.
• Able to perform load calculations, power capacity planning, single-line diagram design, equipment sizing, technical specification writing, and design review independently.
• Familiar with international electrical codes and data center standards, such as IEC, BS, IEEE, NFPA, TIA-942, Uptime Institute Tier Standard, or equivalent frameworks.
• Proficient in AutoCAD and Microsoft Office; experience with Revit, BIM coordination, ETAP, Dialux, or other electrical design and analysis tools is preferred.
• Strong communication, coordination, technical judgement, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal cross-functional teams.
• Working English capability is required, including the ability to read technical documents and participate in technical discussions; stronger spoken and written English is preferred for overseas projects.
Preferred Qualifications
• Prior experience in data center design, modular data centers, prefabricated electrical modules, power skids, containerized solutions, or overseas data center projects.
• Experience working with international consultants, EPC contractors, equipment vendors, or customers in Southeast Asia or other overseas markets.
• Professional qualifications such as Registered Electrical Worker, Chartered Engineer, Professional Engineer, CDCP/CDCS, or equivalent certifications are an advantage.
• Experience supporting pre-sales, tendering, technical proposal review, factory acceptance testing, commissioning, or value engineering for data center projects is preferred.
