title: HVAC Engineer - Data Center Design
teaser: This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.
jd:
Role Overview
The company is launching a new brand focused on data center development and prefabricated product delivery. We are looking for an HVAC Engineer who can independently lead mechanical and cooling system design for data center projects, supporting design development, technical review, tendering, prefabricated product delivery, and overseas project implementation.
This role will serve as the HVAC discipline owner across design and delivery interfaces, working closely with electrical, architecture, structural, product, pre-sales, project delivery, vendors, and external consultants to ensure the cooling system is reliable, energy-efficient, maintainable, and aligned with international data center standards.
>
Key Responsibilities
• Independently lead HVAC and cooling system design for data center projects, including concept design, schematic design, design development, technical coordination, and design review.
• Develop and review cooling system architecture covering chilled water systems, air-cooled or water-cooled solutions, CRAH/CRAC units, chillers, pumps, cooling towers, heat rejection, ventilation, pressurization, and controls interfaces.
• Prepare and review HVAC drawings, load calculations, psychrometric analysis, equipment schedules, technical specifications, design narratives, and sequence of operations.
• Support prefabricated data center product design by translating project requirements into standardized cooling modules, piping interfaces, factory testing requirements, and installation-ready deliverables.
• Coordinate with electrical, structural, architectural, fire services, BMS/DCIM, and ICT disciplines to resolve cross-discipline interfaces, space planning, maintainability, and constructability issues.
• Provide technical support for pre-sales and tendering, including technical proposals, tender clarifications, customer meetings, value engineering, energy efficiency analysis, and technical risk assessments.
• Review vendor submissions, equipment selections, factory acceptance test requirements, control logic, and technical deviations to ensure compliance with project specifications and data center reliability requirements.
• Support project delivery teams during construction, commissioning, integrated systems testing, issue resolution, and handover, ensuring design intent is maintained through implementation.
• Track international data center HVAC standards, cooling technology trends, energy efficiency requirements, and regulatory requirements across target overseas markets.
>
Requirements & Qualifications
• Bachelor degree or above in HVAC or a related discipline.
• 5+ years of HVAC or mechanical design experience, with hands-on experience in data centers, mission-critical facilities, industrial facilities, or large-scale infrastructure projects.
• Proven ability to independently lead HVAC discipline design for data center or mission-critical projects, from early-stage design through detailed design and delivery support.
• Strong knowledge of data center cooling systems, including chilled water systems, CRAH/CRAC units, chillers, pumps, cooling towers, airflow management, redundancy architecture, and reliability design.
• Able to perform cooling load calculations, equipment sizing, airflow and pressure analysis, system schematics, technical specification writing, and design review independently.
• Familiar with international HVAC codes and data center standards, such as ASHRAE, CIBSE, SMACNA, TIA-942, Uptime Institute Tier Standard, or equivalent frameworks.
• Proficient in AutoCAD and Microsoft Office; experience with Revit, BIM coordination, CFD analysis, HAP, IESVE, or other HVAC design and simulation tools is preferred.
• Strong communication, coordination, technical judgement, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal cross-functional teams.
• Working English capability is required, including the ability to read technical documents and participate in technical discussions; stronger spoken and written English is preferred for overseas projects.
>
Preferred Qualifications
• Prior experience in data center design, modular data centers, prefabricated cooling modules, cooling skids, containerized solutions, or overseas data center projects.
• Experience working with international consultants, EPC contractors, equipment vendors, or customers in Southeast Asia or other overseas markets.
• Professional qualifications such as Chartered Engineer, Professional Engineer, CEng, RPE, CDCP/CDCS, or equivalent certifications are an advantage.
• Experience supporting pre-sales, tendering, technical proposal review, factory acceptance testing, commissioning, integrated systems testing, or value engineering for data center projects is preferred.

title: Responsible Sourcing Specialist (1 year contract)
teaser: Make a real impact by helping suppliers improve ethical performance and build a more responsible supply chain for Tesco.
bullet_points: Drive positive change for workers and communities.
Partner with suppliers across Asia and global teams.
Grow your career in ethical and sustainable sourcing.
jd:
We are now recruiting for a Responsible Sourcing Specialist (1 year contract) based in Hong Kong.
About the role
This role reports to our Responsible Sourcing Manager in China and work closely with five team members located in Hong Kong and South China. It plays an important part in delivering Tesco’s Responsible Sourcing strategy across our Home and Clothing supply base. You will work closely with suppliers and internal teams to identify ethical risks, deliver responsible sourcing programmes and support improvements that protect workers and strengthen supplier performance. You will also help build supplier capability and contribute to a more responsible, future ready supply base. This is a great opportunity to gain hands on experience in global supply chains, stakeholder management and ethical compliance, with opportunities to visit factories across Mainland China and Southeast Asia.
The team you’ll work with
The Responsible Sourcing team is a global function with members located around the world, led by the Head of Responsible Sourcing based in Hong Kong. We work closely with colleagues in the UK and other stakeholders across hubs, including Commercial, Supply Chain and Technical.
We are committed to upholding the highest ethical standards to ensure that everyone who works with or for us is treated with dignity and respect. Our goal is to buy and sell ethically, acting as a force for good and creating a positive impact for people in our supply chains and the wider sourcing communities.
You will be responsible for
Assess and approve supply base suitability by conducting factory assessments, supporting new factory onboarding, monitoring supplier performance and facilitating the exit of poor-performing sites where required.
Drive ethical compliance and risk management by supporting suppliers in completing ethical audits, closing non-compliances and implementing corrective action plans to meet Tesco requirements.
Execute ethical performance programmes including ethical ratings, supply base analysis, target tracking and regular progress reviews to support responsible sourcing objectives.
Build supplier capability and drive continuous improvement through supplier empowerment initiatives, improvement projects and sharing best practices that strengthen long-term ethical performance.
Deliver supplier engagement activities by organising workshops, training sessions and communications to enhance understanding of Tesco's responsible sourcing requirements.
Act as the ethical advisor for the supply base , partnering closely with Commercial and Technical teams to integrate ethical considerations into sourcing decisions and support supply base development.
Monitor the effectiveness of responsible sourcing programmes and service providers through activities such as shadow audits, quality reviews and stakeholder feedback to ensure consistent standards.
Promote collaboration, innovation and operational excellence by managing priorities effectively, identifying continuous improvement opportunities, sharing knowledge with colleagues and always acting with integrity in line with Tesco's Business Code of Conduct.
You will need
Essential Experience
Always acting with integrity and due diligence
Effective communication and interpersonal skills
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
Detail oriented
Willing to travel frequently (e.g. Mainland China and other SEA countries)
Knowledge / experience in manufacturing and industry ethical programme
Preferred Experience
Experience in social/ ethical audit
What’s in it for you
We offer a range of benefits that help make Tesco a great place to work. Benefits may vary by location and will be confirmed as part of the recruitment process. These may include:
Flexible working arrangements
Contract end gratuity
Life and medical insurance cover after 3 months of service
Opportunities to convert to a permanent contract
>

teaser: Lead IT security assurance, risk assessments and testing activities, driving cyber risk mitigation, vendor governance and secure technology delivery
jd:
Role Introduction
>
Drive the security assurance and testing practices that help protect Cathay's technology landscape. You will lead IT security assessments, oversee security testing activities, and ensure projects, applications, vendors, and technology initiatives are evaluated against security requirements, risk standards, and industry best practices. Working across assurance and testing disciplines, you will help teams understand security exposures, evaluate mitigation options, and make informed risk-based decisions.
>Partnering with stakeholders across Information Technology and the wider business, you will oversee security testing quality, manage external testing vendors, guide responses to security findings, and develop frameworks covering areas such as cloud security assessments, contractual security requirements, and risk assessment methodologies. Your expertise in security standards, penetration testing practices, vulnerability assessment, ethical hacking, and threat awareness will help strengthen security outcomes across both project delivery and operational environments.
>This is a role for a security professional who enjoys combining technical depth with leadership. By mentoring team members, improving assurance processes, promoting secure development practices, and influencing security decisions at multiple levels, you will help deliver a stronger and more resilient technology environment that supports Cathay's commitment to moving people forward in life.
>
Key Responsibilities
>
>
Lead IT security risk assessments and security assurance activities, ensuring identified risks and mitigation actions are appropriately managed and tracked.
Advise senior stakeholders on residual risks, vulnerabilities, security exposures, information asset misuse, and security non-compliance.
Evaluate security risks associated with exception requests and recommend appropriate mitigation measures to business units.
Develop, maintain, and continuously improve security assessment frameworks, testing procedures, methodologies, standards, and guidelines.
Drive efficiency and consistency in assurance activities through the enhancement of control assessment approaches and security governance practices.
Oversee security testing delivery across projects and business-as-usual activities, ensuring testing approaches, documentation, and outcomes are fit for purpose.
Manage external testing vendors, assessment tools, testing quality standards, and acceptance criteria to ensure effective and reliable security testing outcomes.
Prioritize and coordinate internal and external security testing resources while coaching and managing security testing team members.
Investigate and communicate security findings, provide support during security incident resolution, and ensure residual risks are documented and understood by stakeholders.
Promote security awareness and capability development by delivering training, encouraging secure coding practices, and monitoring emerging cyber threats and industry best practices.
>
>
Requirements
>
5-7 years of relevant experience in IT Security Assurance, Security Testing, Risk Assessment, or related cybersecurity disciplines
Experience leading and mentoring small teams, with the ability to manage and develop team members
Relevant security certification such as OSCP, GWAPT, OSEP, OSWE, OSCE, or CEH is preferred for assessment-related responsibilities
Expert knowledge of cyber threats, attack techniques, security testing methodologies, security standards, and assessment tools
Strong vendor management experience, including oversight of external security testing and assessment providers
Hands-on knowledge of security frameworks and practices, including Vulnerability Assessment, IT Risk Assessment, Penetration Testing, Ethical Hacking, OWASP, NIST, OSSTMM, and OSINT
Expert understanding of security solutions and tools used across assessment, testing, and assurance activities
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate security risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Excellent interpersonal, analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with strong troubleshooting capabilities

title: Head of Quality Assurance Testing - IO Tech Solutions
teaser:
You will lead Quality & Reliability Engineering (QRE) — the team responsible for product quality
and production reliability across SleekFlow. You...
jd:
You will lead Quality & Reliability Engineering (QRE) — the team responsible for product quality
and production reliability across SleekFlow. You own the testing strategy, the test platform,
release quality gates, observability and diagnostic tooling, incident management, and availability
reporting. You report to engineering leadership.
What you'll own
1. Testing Strategy & Platform
● Framework Ownership: Builds and maintains the E2E frameworks, CI integration, and
test-data management used daily by application engineers.
● Automated & Proactive Testing: Drives continuous, multi-tiered regression testing based
on real production patterns, and leads pre-release and exploratory testing programs.
● Shared Responsibility: The platform team provides the infrastructure and framework,
while application engineers write the actual feature tests.
2. Release Quality & Delivery
● Policy Setting: Defines the release-quality policy (which gates a release, which test
suites run, and how rollbacks are triggered) based on the change's risk level.
● Pipeline Enforcement: Owns what the pipeline enforces, while release engineers
manage pipeline execution.
3. Observability & Diagnostic Tooling
● Platform & Standards: Owns the infrastructure and standards for structured logging,
metrics, tracing, and alerting to ensure production issues are easily diagnosable.
● Data Pipelines: Manages the tools and pipelines, while separate application and platform
teams handle the actual instrumentation of their services.
4. Incident Management
● Lifecycle Ownership: Coordinates the entire response for all production incidents
(severity classification, stakeholder communication, and postmortems) regardless of the
root cause.
● Continuous Learning: Tracks post-incident follow-ups and feeds lessons learned back
into testing and monitoring improvements. (The team that caused the issue owns the fix).
5. Availability, Stability, & Reliability
● Target Definition: Co-defines system availability, degradation, and downtime targets with
leadership.
● Metrics & Reporting: Translates definitions into measurable SLIs and health signals,
builds operational dashboards, and produces regular reliability reports to guide quality
investments.
What we’re looking for
10+ years in software engineering, quality engineering, or production reliability, with at least 3–4
years in a leadership role (managing people, setting org-level strategy, influencing cross-team
decisions).
You’ve worked across both quality engineering and production reliability — either in separate
roles or combined. You understand how product quality and site reliability reinforce each other
and can explain that to an engineering org.
Specific experience we value:
● Designing tiered regression strategies — deciding what to run per repo or change class
in CI/CD so delivery stays fast without blind spots.
● Running incident response end-to-end — from detection to postmortem to tracked
prevention — for a multi-service, multi-region SaaS product.
● Building or scaling a test automation platform used by other engineers daily (E2E
frameworks, CI pipelines, test-data management, flake policy).
● Building or owning observability infrastructure — structured logging, distributed tracing,
metrics pipelines, and alerting — that engineers rely on daily to diagnose production
issues.
● Defining availability or reliability metrics (SLIs, SLOs, or equivalent) and making them
mean something to leadership — not just dashboards that exist but that nobody trusts.
● Operating in a fast-shipping engineering culture where features are built in days, specs
are often thin, and the quality model has to keep pace.
● You translate between “5xx on service X” and “inbox is broken for customers.” You
present quality and availability to leadership in business terms and work with engineers
in technical terms. You’re comfortable being the person who says “this isn’t ready to
ship” when it matters.
Nice to have
● Hands-on with Playwright or similar modern E2E frameworks and CI-driven test
pipelines.
● Experience with multi-region SaaS (Azure preferred, but cloud-native fundamentals
transfer).
● Experience with structured pre-release testing programs (internal beta, dogfooding) at a
product company.
● Experience co-defining customer-facing SLAs or availability reporting with product or
leadership.

location: Lok Ma Chau, Yuen Long District
teaser:
Work In Shenzhen 
Modules end-to-end
Good in using AI tools
jd:
About the role
We build the internal software that runs a packaging and apparel-trim manufacturing business: product costing engines that price real customer quotations, a QC inspection system used on the factory floor, an accounting and VAT module for our Vietnam entity, an AI document-search tool, and RFID/GS1 supply-chain tooling. Eight modules, four deployment environments, one small team.
This is not a ticket-taking job. You will own a module end-to-end: sit with the costing manager or the QC lead, understand what they actually need, design it, build it — frontend and backend — test it, ship it, and answer for it in production. You will work alongside AI coding tools every day. We expect you to be fast because of them, and we expect you to be the reason the output is correct.
What you'll do
Own one or more modules end-to-end — API, UI, database, tests, deployment.
Work directly with non-technical business users in Chinese: turn a screenshot and a complaint into a precise, correct change.
Build calculation engines whose output is used to quote real business. A number that is quietly wrong is the most expensive failure here — you are expected to prove correctness, not assert it.
Read from our ERP (IBM DB2) through a read-only query gateway; write the portal's own state to PostgreSQL.
Ship through our engineering standard: plan doc → feature branch → build → six CI gates green locally → self-review → PR → merge → watch the deploy.
Write the documentation that keeps the next person — or the next AI — correct.
What you need
3+ years shipping production web applications, including at least one where you owned both backend and frontend.
Python and TypeScript, both professionally. Our stack is FastAPI + Pydantic and React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind.
Strong SQL — you can debug a slow join, read an unfamiliar schema by querying it, and reason about a database you are not allowed to write to.
Professional Chinese and working technical English. Our code, documentation and Vietnam-team communication are in English; our users and our domain vocabulary are in Chinese.
Daily use of AI coding tools, and a clear-eyed view of where they fail. Be ready to tell us about a time the model was confidently wrong and how you caught it.
Testing as a habit. Git fluency — branches, rebase, clean PRs.
Comfort with ambiguity: you'd rather spend an hour with the user than an hour guessing.
Nice to have
Manufacturing, printing, packaging or apparel supply-chain background · product costing or BOM systems · QC / AQL · ERP experience (SAP, Oracle, MMS, 用友, 金蝶) · Docker and Linux service operations · OIDC/OAuth2 · RAG or vector search · RFID / GS1 · Vietnamese.

Product Development Engineer — Wearable Medical Devices / Neuromodulation
Dr.SisLab is a women’s health technology initiative developing accessible tools for menstrual health risk identification and personalized management through menstrual data, menstrual blood biomarkers, and digital health technologies.
We are now exploring a new R&D direction: a non-invasive wearable neuromodulation device—potentially ear-worn, patch-based, or abdominal-worn—for the management of primary dysmenorrhea (menstrual pain).
This program is at an early scientific validation and product concept stage. We do not intend to market unvalidated technology as an established treatment. Instead, we aim to rigorously assess its safety, usability, clinical feasibility, and commercial potential through sound engineering, clinical research, and responsible medical-device development.
We are looking for a hands-on Product Development Engineer to help define, prototype, test, and iterate our first-generation wearable device.

Translate clinical needs, scientific hypotheses, and user scenarios into product and engineering requirements
Evaluate possible device formats, including ear-worn, adhesive patch, and abdominal wearable systems

Support development of stimulation-output control, impedance monitoring, battery/charging systems, Bluetooth connectivity, and basic mobile-app integration

Contribute to early IP strategy, grant applications, technical documentation, and regulatory planning

Act as the technical interface between internal AI algorithm, embedded software, hardware, product, and supply-chain teams and external IC design, layout, foundry, packaging, testing, and manufacturing partners.

制定项目研发计划与技术里程碑，把控项目进度与关键技术风险，确保产品按时高质量交付。
负责系统级集成验证与系统测试，建立完整的需求追溯矩阵，确保需求被充分验证。

确保产品研发流程符合ISO 13485、ISO 14971（风险管理）、IEC 60601-1系列等医疗器械法规与标准要求。
主导产品全生命周期的风险管理活动（DFMEA、风险分析报告等）。
与临床团队及医疗机构深度合作，推动产品的临床验证与注册申报（NMPA/FDA/CE）。
任职要求
1. 教育背景
硕士及以上学历，生物医学工程、声学/水声工程、电子工程、信号与信息处理、物理、医学影像或相关专业，博士学历优先。
2. 工作经验
8年以上医疗超声设备或复杂有源医疗器械的系统级研发经验。
3年以上超声产品系统架构设计或技术领导岗位经验。
完整主导过至少1个二类或三类有源医疗器械产品从概念到上市的全生命周期项目。
有高端台式超声、神经调控、脑机接口相关产品研发经验者优先。
3. 专业技术能力
深厚的超声系统知识：精通超声成像/调控系统的工作原理、系统架构与信号链路，熟悉B模式、多普勒、平面波成像、超快成像、波束合成等核心技术。
前沿超声专项能力：深刻理解前沿超声的物理挑战（声学强衰减、声学畸变、焦点偏移等），熟悉多阵元相控阵、相位校正、个体化校准等关键技术。
跨学科系统思维：具备宽广的技术视野，精通电子硬件、信号处理、成像算法、换能器声学、嵌入式软件等多个技术领域中的至少2-3项，能有效协调各子系统的设计、集成与优化。
法规与标准：熟悉医疗器械开发流程与质量体系，精通ISO 13485、ISO 14971、IEC 60601-1等法规标准。
4. 综合能力
出色的技术领导力与团队管理能力，能有效带领跨学科团队攻克复杂技术难题。
优秀的沟通协调能力，能与临床医生、产品管理、注册法规、生产制造等多方高效协作。
良好的技术文档撰写能力与英文读写能力。
具备战略思维与全局观，能准确理解市场需求并转化为技术规划。

4.有AI辅助成像/智能超声相关算法研发经验。
5.有PMP证书或实际项目管理经验。

title: Mechatronics Engineer (Part-time / Full-time)
teaser: Grab this chance to be part of a startup driving meaningful impact in the footwear industry and leading critical environmental improvements!
jd:
About Tailo
At Tailo Tech Limited, we are transforming how the world thinks about footwear fit and bespoke manufacturing. What drives our passion is the absolute tangibility of our mission—we are not just iterating on another software app. Backed by HKSTP and secured by core US patents, we are actively solving the complex gap between digital biometrics and bespoke physical manufacturing.
Our core technology spans a comprehensive three-part ecosystem: a physical sizing machine, a dedicated tracking app, and a fully automated custom production line. By merging custom robotics, advanced spatial scanning, and automated 3D printing workflows, we are redefining the future of the footwear industry. By shifting from traditional mass production to on-demand bespoke manufacturing, our technology directly eliminates the massive material waste that currently plagues global footwear. Joining us means your engineering decisions immediately translate into personalized, physical products, giving you total ownership over your technical vision within a highly driven, fast-moving team.
You will work directly with our Co-founder and CEO—who is the primary inventor of our proprietary system logic, experienced in complex system architecture and tactical, high-stakes engineering, and forensic science machinery from his unique background. You will also learn the mechanics of scaling technical innovation from our Co-founder who focuses on operations. Her proven expertise in architecting brands and large-scale projects, managing high-end customers, and navigating complex corporate infrastructures ensures you have the commercial muscle and operational runway to focus entirely on engineering. You are never just a cog in a machine; you are empowered by leadership that deeply understands both the hardware trenches and the commercial lifecycle.
>
The Challenge & Key Responsibilities
>We are not looking for someone to just maintain systems; we need a driven Mechatronics Engineer to help build them. You will work at the intersection of custom robotics, automated sizing algorithms, and dynamic 3D printing workflows. If you are passionate about footprint heat-mapping, complex hardware-software integration, and scaling bespoke hardware systems, here is how you will help us build the future of footwear:
Mechanical Build & 3D Printing: Slicing and 3D printing custom structural components for our multi-joint robotic arm, handling the physical assembly, and managing hardware mounting.
Motor Control & Actuation: Wiring and programming stepper/servo motors to drive the physical elevator mechanisms and arm joints smoothly and accurately.
Firmware & Machine Logic: Writing the core software (C/C++ or Python) on microcontrollers (ESP32/STM32) to sequence the machine's automated movements and coordinate the dual-sensor tool head.
Spatial Data & Point Clouds: Integrating Time-of-Flight (ToF) sensors and writing the data pipeline to extract raw distance metrics, transforming them into a clean, visual 3D point cloud on a digital dashboard.
>
Role Highlights
Role: Mechatronics Engineer (Hybrid Part-time / Full-time)
Duration & Commitment: 3-Month Term (September – November 2026), potentially transitioning to a long-term role afterward, with an explicit path to a permanent career track.
Environment: Direct access to state-of-the-art HKSTP robotics labs, advanced fabrication tools, and a dedicated workspace at Science Park.
>
Requirements
Current student or recent graduate from a B.Sc / M.Sc / PhD program in Mechatronics, Robotics, Automation, or Electronic/Mechanical Engineering from a university in Hong Kong.
Strong hands-on experience with microcontroller programming, sensor data handling, 3D printing workflows, and electronic hardware debugging.
Highly self-motivated and thrive at the intersection of hardware and software. You love getting your hands dirty building physical prototypes (e.g., RC cars, drones, Robocon projects) and writing the code that brings them to life.
>
If you think you would be a great fit for our team, please apply with your resume. We will conduct interviews on a rolling basis and notify all candidates of the outcome by mid-September 2026
>
If you have any questions, feel free to contact us via ••••@tailo.tech
>
Grab this chance to be part of a startup driving meaningful impact in the footwear industry and leading critical environmental improvements!

二、崗位介紹 ：
本崗位為增材製造AI前沿部署工程師（FDE） ，核心定位是打通AI技術與工業生產場景，聚焦金屬3D列印全流程的AI落地應用。候選人核心價值在於懂AI應用、懂工業落地、擅長場景挖掘與方案驗證 ，能夠結合AI大模型、RAG、智能自動化等技術，梳理適配SLM金屬列印的高價值場景，落地工藝知識庫、自動化工藝開發、智能缺陷分析、軟體流程智能化等應用，推動AI技術從原型驗證走向規模化工業落地。
三、崗位職責：
工業AI場景挖掘與梳理 ：深入熟悉金屬增材製造全業務流程，圍繞工藝開發、參數優化、品質檢測、知識沉澱等核心痛點，挖掘、篩選高價值、可落地的AI應用場景，完成需求定義、優先順序排序與落地規劃
AI方案設計與落地應用 ：依託大模型、RAG、AI Agent等技術，整合內外部AI工具、開源能力及第三方資源，獨立設計端到端AI應用方案。核心落地實現工藝自動化開發、工藝參數智能優化、缺陷智能分析、工藝知識庫搭建等核心能力
內外部資源統籌落地 ：統籌推進AI專案落地，對內拉通工藝、生產、軟體、演算法團隊對齊落地節奏；對外整合AI廠商、技術服務商等外部資源，補齊技術能力，打通落地壁壘，推動AI場景從試點驗證走向規模化複用。
工業數據與智能資產沉澱 ：依託企業工藝資料、實驗數據、生產案例，搭建標準化增材製造工藝知識庫、知識圖譜；聯動SLM軟體、工藝資料庫，完成數據清洗、特徵梳理，搭建自動化工藝開發工作流，沉澱可複用的工業AI應用資產。
效果量化複盤與複製推廣： 建立AI落地量化評估體系，從工藝週期、調試效率、缺陷率、知識複用等維度量化落地價值。定期複盤迭代，沉澱標準化落地規範與案例，推動優質AI場景批量複製落地。
行業前沿跟進與場景創新 ：持續調研工業AI及增材製造智能化前沿方案，對標行業先進落地案例，挖掘全新應用場景，持續拓展AI賦能智能製造的落地邊界，提升公司整體工藝智能化水準。

博士及以上學歷，電腦、人工智慧、大數據、自動化、軟體工程、機械、材料等相關專業，5年AI在工業領域落地經驗。
具備扎實的AI應用落地能力，熟悉RAG知識庫、Prompt工程、AI Agent智能工作流，瞭解工業大模型應用邏輯，不局限於演算法理論，側重落地實操。

具備出色的跨部門溝通協調與協同推進能力，善於聯動不同職能團隊對齊目標、打通協作壁壘，高效推動AI專案落地迭代。

jd:
About STRELI
STRELI Technology Limited is a growing technology startup working at the intersection of industrial intelligence, smart manufacturing, and automation. We develop industrial intelligence solutions for process manufacturing and have been working closely with leading international industry partners to improve manufacturing efficiency, resilience, and sustainability. Backed by a highly dedicated team of world-class scientists and engineers, we aim to lead the real-world deployment of industrial intelligence in the market.
Role Overview
As an Industrial IT/OT Engineer, you will play a hands-on role in connecting factory-floor systems to modern software and cloud-based data platforms. The role focuses on IT/OT integration, industrial connectivity, and the reliable flow of data between PLCs, sensors, edge devices, and central servers. You will work closely with on-site industrial engineers, control engineers, and data scientists, supporting the deployment, configuration, and operation of industrial systems in real manufacturing environments.
This is a hands-on, system-facing role at the boundary between industrial operations and modern software infrastructure. As an early member of a growing startup, the role demands high ownership and adaptability, while offering rapid skill development, deep industrial exposure, and strong compensation for impact.
Key Responsibilities
· Research and implement IT/OT hardware integration to stream data from factory equipment (PLCs, sensors, SCADA) into STRELI’s edge devices
· Research, design, and configure industrial edge devices and gateways for reliable connection to different factory control systems
· Research and configure data acquisition paths from sensors and PLCs, via gateways, into the edge device, with correct signal/factory tag mapping and timing
· Research and support on-site deployment and operation of edge devices in active factory environments, adapting configurations to local constraints
· Work with industrial communication protocols (OPC UA, Modbus, Profinet, EtherNet/IP, or similar) to interface with factory equipment
· Implement factory-side networking, security, and access control for gateways and edge devices
· Collaborate with control and data engineers to ensure collected industrial data is suitable for monitoring, optimisation, and analytics workflows
· Support on-site testing, troubleshooting, and maintenance of deployed industrial systems
Requirements
· Bachelor’s degree or higher (Master/PhD preferred) in Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline
· 2–4+ years of experience in industrial IT/OT systems, industrial networking, automation support, or applied industrial engineering
· Hands-on experience with industrial IT/OT systems, factory networks, and plant IT infrastructure
· Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (e.g. OPC UA, Modbus, Profinet, EtherNet/IP, MQTT)
· Experience working with Linux-based systems, industrial PCs, or edge computing platform
· Basic proficiency in Python, scripting, or similar tools for system integration, diagnostics, or data handling
· Understanding of industrial cybersecurity fundamentals and secure system integration practices
· Industrial IT/OT and industrial cybersecurity certifications (e.g. IEC 62443 or equivalent) are highly desirable; the role focuses on IT/OT integration rather than PLC programming
· Ability to document and communicate technical work clearly in English and Mandarin
Why Join STRELI
· Gain experience in a company that drives industrial sustainability and energy efficiency at scale, as part of a team shaping the next generation of industrial intelligence
· Gain broad exposure across operations and business functions, working closely with major industry partners in a technology-driven environment
· Work closely with a small, dedicated team delivering real-world industrial solutions, with opportunities to learn and make a meaningful impact in industrial intelligence
· Join STRELI at an early stage and grow with the company, taking on real responsibility and helping shape its direction

>First Circle is a fast-growing, profitable, credit-led SME neobank in the Philippines, backed by shareholders including the World Bank Group (IFC). Thousands of SMEs use our Business Credit Line and Business Bank Accounts to run and grow their businesses. Our product velocity continues to accelerate, with upcoming launches including SME Corporate Cards, Payroll, Invoices, and Solar Financing - redefining the SME neobank category through software, financial products, and exceptional risk models.
Our culture emphasises building, problem solving, ownership / responsibility, and personal & professional growth. We balance a collegiate atmosphere with free & direct communication which enables us to move very quickly and avoid politics or toxicity. Our team continues to level up quickly, necessary for business to compound more than 100% per year, which we achieve through individual growth and bar-raiser hiring.

Profitable
150% YoY growth
$25-50m revenue
Responsibilities
>As VP of Engineering, you will be the most senior technical leader in the business, reporting directly to the CEO. You will own engineering output end-to-end: from system design and domain architecture to delivery velocity, team culture, and the platform decisions that define the next chapters of our journey.
This is not a role for a detached engineering executive. We are looking for a technically excellent leader who understands that solving the hardest problems means being hands-on, not someone who manages through process and delegation. The ideal candidate raises the bar on every dimension of engineering quality, and builds the engineering organisation which will enable us to become the dominant SME NeoBank across Southeast Asia.
Product Velocity & Quality
Evolve the engineering delivery framework - sprint cadence, definition of done, code review standards, and release processes
Drive meaningful improvement in lead time, deployment frequency, and change failure rate (DORA metrics)
Balance feature velocity against technical debt with rigour and transparency
Partner with Product to co-own the technical roadmap, sequencing build decisions against architectural dependencies
Architecture & System Design
Define and enforce domain boundaries across a microservices landscape, including cross-service messaging patterns, event contracts, and data consistency models
Own data modelling standards and schema governance across services
Lead design reviews for significant architectural decisions: ledger design, transaction state machines, reconciliation, and authorisation flows
Build the architecture review process - lightweight enough to not slow teams down, rigorous enough to prevent expensive mistakes
Regulatory, Security & Non-Functional Requirements
Own the technical implementation of MAS TRM Guidelines and/or HKMA SPM on IT
Lead PCI-DSS compliance engineering and scope management
Drive adoption of the Azure Well-Architected Framework across all workloads
Define and maintain SLA/SLO frameworks, on-call rotation design, and post-mortem culture
Own cloud cost governance, capacity planning, and tooling budget
AI in Engineering
Evolve and implement out the firm's AI-assisted development strategy
Stay close to the emerging agentic engineering landscape and make deliberate adoption decisions
Provide architectural guidance on model integration, data pipelines, and inference infrastructure
API, Integration & Vendor Strategy
Own the API design philosophy for internal and external-facing services
Hold the technical relationship with key infrastructure partners - issuer processors, core banking providers, cloud vendors
Define the integration pattern library and partner onboarding standards
Data Platform
Accountability for data infrastructure: pipelines, warehouse, and models feeding BI and regulatory reporting
Ensure data lineage, quality, and governance standards are fit for a regulated entity
Team Leadership & Hiring
Hire, develop, lead & manage engineering team leaders: own the org design as the team scales from 25+ to 100+
Drive hiring at all levels - define the bar, run structured processes, attract senior talent
Develop engineering culture: ways of working, documentation standards, incident response norms
Develop career pathways and performance frameworks oriented around A-players
Represent engineering to the board, in investor due diligence, and in regulatory interactions
Requirements
Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline
Deep expertise in building financial technology - payments, lending, cards, or core banking
Experience managing one or more engineering teams
Proven track record of solving hard technical problems personally
Proven track record hiring and retaining strong engineers
Strong communication in English; ability to translate technical complexity for exec/board audiences
Strong preference for:
>
Deep familiarity with global fintech and/or Southeast Asia tech ecosystem
Prior experience in a high-growth environment
Hands-on Azure architecture experience
Familiarity with card and payments infrastructure (issuer processors, scheme rules, clearing flows)
Experience within a regulated entity or navigating a licensing process
Benefits
Competitive base salary with outcome-based bonuses and significant equity participation
High impact role with meaningful influence over company direction
Flexibility to work remotely with opportunities for travel
Macbooks, health insurance, training budget, and more!

title: 具身智慧演算法工程師
teaser: 負責將端到端具身智慧演算法及模型在機器人本體上進行部署與調試，確保演算法在真機環境中能夠流暢運行，解決部署過程中出現的相容性、穩定性等問題。​ 針對機器人端側硬體資源特點，優化具身智慧演算法的運行效率，降低演算法對端側...
jd:
負責將端到端具身智慧演算法及模型在機器人本體上進行部署與調試，確保演算法在真機環境中能夠流暢運行，解決部署過程中出現的相容性、穩定性等問題。​
針對機器人端側硬體資源特點，優化具身智慧演算法的運行效率，降低演算法對端側 CPU、記憶體、算力等資源的佔用，提升機器人在實際場景中的回應速度與續航能力。​
協同演算法研發、硬體開發等跨團隊成員，明確演算法部署需求與硬體適配標準，推動端到端具身智慧技術在機器人產品上的落地應用，保障專案按計劃推進。​
跟蹤具身智慧演算法在機器人真機運行過程中的性能資料，分析演算法運行瓶頸，持續反覆運算優化演算法部署方案，提升機器人的智慧化交互與執行能力。
關鍵產出
交付機器人真機部署端到端具身智慧演算法的整套方案，方案需包含演算法選型、部署架構、資源適配策略、性能優化方案等核心內容，且經過真機驗證可穩定落地。​
輸出詳細的真機部署手冊，手冊需清晰說明部署流程、環境配置要求、操作步驟、常見問題排查方法等，確保團隊成員可依據手冊獨立完成演算法部署工作。​
提交完整的開發日誌，記錄演算法部署過程中的關鍵節點、技術難點及解決方案、性能測試資料、反覆運算優化記錄等，為後續專案複盤與技術沉澱提供支撐。​
交付演算法端側優化成果報告，包含優化前後的演算法效率（如回應時間、幀率）、資源佔用（如 CPU 使用率、記憶體佔用率）等關鍵指標對比資料，驗證優化方案的有效性。
能力要求
電腦科學、機械工程、自動化或相關理工科專業碩士及以上學歷
具備扎實的具身智慧演算法理論基礎，熟悉端到端演算法模型（如強化學習、視覺 - 動作融合模型等），有相關演算法研發或部署經驗者優先。​
掌握機器人端側開發技術，瞭解主流機器人硬體架構（如嵌入式系統、算力模組），能夠熟練使用 C++/Python 等程式設計語言及 TensorRT、ONNX Runtime 等模型部署工具。​
擁有較強的問題分析與解決能力，能夠快速定位演算法部署過程中的性能瓶頸、相容性問題，並提出有效的優化方案，確保演算法在真機上穩定高效運行。​
具備良好的跨團隊協作與溝通能力，能夠與演算法研發、硬體開發、測試等團隊緊密配合，推動專案進度，同時有較強的責任心與抗壓能力，可適應專案攻堅需求。

title: Mechanical Design & Product Engineering Researcher
teaser: This role focuses on the mechanical design, materials engineering, and product development R&D required to transform robotic character prototypes...
jd:
This role focuses on the mechanical design, materials engineering, and product development R&D required to transform robotic character prototypes into production-ready systems. You will research and develop compact mechanism designs, novel linkage systems, soft-shell structures, and manufacturing processes for robotic characters with non-standard morphologies. You will also apply data-driven methods to optimise design parameters, material selection, and production quality assurance.
R&D Responsibilities
Research and develop compact mechanical assemblies for robotic characters, including asymmetric leg mechanisms, spherical and planar linkage systems, and remotely actuated show functions (eyes, mouth, arms).
Conduct materials research for soft-shell structures (polyurethane foam skirts, stretch-fabric costumes) and magnetic attachment systems, evaluating mechanical properties, durability, and manufacturability.
Develop design-for-manufacturability (DFM) methodologies for transitioning R&D prototypes to small-batch and volume production, including tolerance analysis, assembly process design, and supplier qualification protocols.
Apply computational analysis tools (CAD, FEA, MATLAB) to simulate mechanical behaviour, optimise structural designs, and validate mechanism kinematics under operational loads.
Develop data-driven quality assurance frameworks using statistical analysis and machine learning to monitor production consistency and predict component failure modes.
Coordinate with actuator and component suppliers to research and evaluate new actuator technologies, materials, and manufacturing processes for cost and performance optimisation.
Support the embedded systems and RL teams by providing accurate mechanical models, actuator characterisation data, and hardware integration specifications.
Document R&D findings in technical reports and contribute to patent applications and academic publications.
Requirements
Bachelor or Master degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science and Engineering, Mechatronics, Industrial Engineering, or a closely related STEM discipline from a recognised institution.
Demonstrated experience in product structural design, 3D CAD modelling (SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or equivalent), and engineering drawing creation.
Hands-on experience with full-cycle product development from concept design through prototyping to production.
Understanding of manufacturing processes, materials characterisation, and supply chain coordination for hardware products.
Proficiency in analytical and computational tools (MATLAB, ANSYS, Python, or R) for design optimisation and data analysis.
Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional, bilingual (English/Chinese) R&D team.
Desirable
Experience with linkage mechanism design, kinematic analysis, or compliant/soft mechanism research.
Background in consumer electronics, robotics, or electromechanical product development.
Experience with rapid prototyping (3D printing, CNC machining) and small-batch manufacturing.
Familiarity with statistical quality control, design of experiments (DOE), or data-driven manufacturing optimisation.
Entrepreneurial experience or track record of taking products from R&D to market launch.

title: Laboratory Technical Specialist
teaser: Maintain complete, accurate, and timely experimental records, raw data, protocols, and technical reports in accordance with laboratory...
jd:
Independently conduct multi-omics R&D experiments, with primary responsibility for at least one technical area: single-cell sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, or metabolomics.
Design, develop, test, and optimise experimental workflows, prototypes, and proof-of-concept solutions to support research and product-development projects.
Execute laboratory experiments in accordance with established protocols, including sample preparation, nucleic acid extraction, library preparation, sequencing workflow support, quality control, and troubleshooting.
Conduct literature reviews and technical research on emerging technologies, experimental methods, materials, and relevant industry developments; translate findings into practical R&D recommendations.
Analyse experimental results, identify technical issues, and support the testing and optimisation of new or existing assay workflows, including underperforming or inactive projects as assigned.
Maintain complete, accurate, and timely experimental records, raw data, protocols, and technical reports in accordance with laboratory documentation requirements.
Maintain laboratory 5S standards and ensure that laboratory activities comply with EHS requirements, SOPs, and quality-management procedures.
Manage laboratory consumables, reagents, and equipment, including inventory checks, maintenance coordination, and troubleshooting support.
Collaborate closely with the R&D Leader and cross-functional teams to deliver project milestones and complete other R&D-related assignments as required.

jd:
Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled Assistant Engineer to deliver quality engineering design in Water Engineering. The role includes carrying out calculations, drawings, and specifications, supporting project and design management, and building strong client relationships.
>Your role
Technical responsibility for engineering design delivery.
Undertake peer design reviews on projects.
Produce and review calculations, drawings, reports and specifications on projects.
Project Management and Design Management of our consultancy services, delivering projects to time and to budget.
Management and technical development of our capabilities and individual Engineers.
Co-ordination, collaboration and management of other disciplines input into projects.
Identify opportunities, lead and support business development and work winning / bidding activities.
Establish, develop and maintain relationships with key existing and prospective clients.
About you
Engineer with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, and Environmental.
Engineering or related discipline.
Minimum of 3 years’ relevant working experience.
Have design experience in at least one of the following: sewage, drainage, wastewater, water and/or utilities engineering.
Have AutoCAD, BIM modelling and hydraulic skills will be an advantage.
Excellent project management skills.
Excellent command of spoken and written English.

Discretionary bonus program.
Relocation assistance.
Transportation & housing allowances (available for remote work locations).

2. 了解基础机械制造工艺、常用材料特性，具备沟通及团队协作能力；
